title.en: Volume 235 Biographies 22: Tu Lai, Zhun Ta, Yi Erde, Nu Shan, A Ji Ge Ni Kan, Tong Tu Lai
title.raw: 卷235 列傳二十二 图赖 准塔 伊尔德 努山 阿济格尼堪 佟图赖

sentences.zh: =圖賴=圖賴，費英東第七子也。

translations.literal: Tu Lai — Tu Lai was the seventh son of Fei Yingdong.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Lai was the seventh son of Fei Yingdong.

sentences.zh: 初隸鑲黃旗，後與兄納蓋、弟蘇完顏改屬正黃旗。

translations.literal: At first he was registered in the Bordered Yellow Banner; later he transferred, together with his elder brother Nagai and younger brother Suwangyan, to the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was first enrolled in the Bordered Yellow Banner, but later he and his elder brother Nagai and younger brother Suwangyan were reassigned to the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年，太宗伐明，略寧遠，二年，伐察哈爾，圖賴皆從。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiancong, Taizong attacked Ming and raided Ningyuan; in the second year he attacked the Chahar, and Tu Lai followed on both campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 1, when Taizong campaigned against Ming and raided Ningyuan, and again in Tiancong 2 against the Chahar, Tu Lai accompanied him both times.

sentences.zh: 三年，复伐明，薄明都，明大同總兵滿桂入援，屯德勝門，圖賴與戰，所殺傷甚眾。

translations.literal: In the third year he again attacked Ming and pressed close to the Ming capital; the Ming Datong commander Man Gui came to relieve it and encamped at Desheng Gate. Tu Lai fought him and killed and wounded a great many.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on another Ming campaign that brought the army up to the capital, the Ming Datong commander Man Gui marched to its relief and took position at Desheng Gate. Tu Lai joined the battle and inflicted heavy casualties.

sentences.zh: 師還，授世職備禦。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was granted the hereditary rank of Defender.
translations.idiomatic: After the army returned, he received the hereditary rank of Defender.

sentences.zh: 四年，從貝勒阿敏守永平，明兵救灤州，阿敏遣巴都禮赴援，圖賴及梅勒額真阿山皆在行。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed Prince Amin in garrisoning Yongping. When Ming troops went to relieve Luanzhou, Amin sent Baduli to assist, and Tu Lai and Meire Ejen Ashan were both in the column.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he served under Prince Amin at Yongping. When Ming forces moved to relieve Luanzhou, Amin dispatched Baduli to their aid, with Tu Lai and Meire Ejen Ashan in the detachment.

sentences.zh: 及阿敏棄永平出邊，明將率步卒百人追擊，圖賴以十六人殿，還戰，盡殲之，進世職游擊。

translations.literal: When Amin abandoned Yongping and withdrew beyond the border, a Ming general pursued with a hundred foot soldiers. Tu Lai with sixteen men brought up the rear, turned back to fight, and annihilated them all, and was promoted to hereditary Guerrilla Colonel.
translations.idiomatic: When Amin abandoned Yongping and withdrew beyond the frontier, a Ming officer pursued with a hundred infantry. Tu Lai held the rear with sixteen men, wheeled about to fight, and wiped them out completely, earning promotion to hereditary Guerrilla Colonel.

sentences.zh: 五年，上伐明，圍大凌河城，命巴牙喇纛章京楊善、鞏阿岱等駐軍壕外，待敵度壕即與戰，而令圖賴與南褚、哈克薩哈當兩旗間，衛樵採；

translations.literal: In the fifth year the emperor attacked Ming and besieged Dalinhe. He ordered Baturu Banner Commanders Yang Shan, Gong Adai, and others to hold troops outside the moat and engage the enemy as soon as they crossed it, while Tu Lai, together with Nanchu and Haksaha, was posted between the two banners to guard the woodcutters.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the emperor campaigned against Ming and laid siege to Dalinhe. He stationed Baturu Banner Commanders Yang Shan, Gong Adai, and others outside the moat to fight any enemy that crossed it, while Tu Lai, Nanchu, and Haksaha were placed between the two banners to protect the foraging parties.

sentences.zh: 城兵出挑戰，圖賴銳入陣，達爾哈以所部繼，貝勒多爾袞亦督兵進，我師薄壕，舍騎步戰，敵阻壕與城上兵爭發砲矢。

translations.literal: The garrison sallied to challenge battle. Tu Lai charged sharply into the formation; Darha followed with his command, and Prince Dorgon also led troops forward. Our army pressed to the moat, dismounted, and fought on foot, while the enemy blocked at the moat and troops on the wall vied in firing cannon and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: When the garrison came out to offer battle, Tu Lai plunged headlong into the enemy line. Darha brought up his troops behind him, and Prince Dorgon advanced as well. Our forces reached the moat, left their horses, and fought on foot, while the defenders held the ditch and the wall and poured down shot and arrows.

sentences.zh: 師退，副將穆克譚、屯布祿，備禦多貝、戈里等皆戰死，圖賴亦被創。

translations.literal: The army withdrew. Deputy Generals Mukedan and Tunbulu, Defenders Duobei, Geli, and others all died in battle, and Tu Lai was also wounded.
translations.idiomatic: The army fell back. Deputy Generals Mukedan and Tunbulu and Defenders Duobei, Geli, and others were killed in action, and Tu Lai was wounded as well.

sentences.zh: 上怒曰：「圖賴輕進，諸軍從之入，朕弟亦衝鋒而進，有不測，將磔爾等食之！

translations.literal: The emperor said in anger: "Tu Lai advanced rashly, and the whole army followed him in. My younger brother also charged forward. Had anything gone wrong, I would have dismembered you and eaten you!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said angrily, "Tu Lai rushed ahead rashly, and the whole army followed him in. My own brother charged forward too. If anything had gone wrong, I would have torn you apart and eaten you!

sentences.zh: 敵如狐處穴，更將焉往？

translations.literal: The enemy are like foxes in their den — where else can they go?
translations.idiomatic: The enemy are like foxes in their burrow — where else can they flee?

sentences.zh: 朕兵天所授，皇考所遺，欲善用之，勿使勞苦。

translations.literal: My troops are what Heaven granted and what my late father bequeathed. I wish to use them well and not wear them out with hardship.
translations.idiomatic: The troops I command were granted by Heaven and left by my late father. I mean to use them wisely and not exhaust them with needless hardship.

sentences.zh: 穆克譚我舊臣，死非其地，豈不可惜？

translations.literal: Mukedan was an old servant of mine. To die in the wrong place — is that not lamentable?
translations.idiomatic: Mukedan was a veteran of mine. That he should die in such a place — is that not a grievous waste?

sentences.zh: 」因誡諸臣毋視圖賴創，揚古利、鞏阿岱偕往存問，上复切責之。

translations.literal: " He then admonished the ministers not to regard Tu Lai's wound, and Yangguli and Gong Adai went together to inquire after him, while the emperor again sharply rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: " He then told the ministers not to make light of Tu Lai's wound and sent Yangguli and Gong Adai together to visit him, though he also rebuked Tu Lai again in stern terms.

sentences.zh: 明監軍道張春等以四萬人來援，次長山，上率諸貝勒御之，圖賴當右翼，躍馬突陣，敵潰走，遂覆其師。

translations.literal: The Ming circuit intendant Zhang Chun and others came to relieve the city with forty thousand men and halted at Changshan. The emperor led the princes to meet them. Tu Lai held the right wing, leaped his horse into the enemy formation, the foe broke and fled, and their army was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Circuit Intendant Zhang Chun and others marched to relieve the siege with forty thousand men and encamped at Changshan. The emperor led the princes out to meet them. Tu Lai commanded the right wing, spurred his horse into the enemy ranks, routed them, and annihilated their force.

sentences.zh: 七年，從攻旅順口。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed in the attack on Lüshunkou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he took part in the assault on Lüshunkou.

sentences.zh: 八年，從伐明，徇大同，攻朔州，拔靈丘，進世職二等。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed in the campaign against Ming, raided Datong, attacked Shuozhou, and captured Lingqiu, and was promoted to second-class hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined the Ming campaign, swept through Datong, attacked Shuozhou, and took Lingqiu, advancing to second-class hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 旋追論攻朔州時越界出略，又不赴期會地，奪俘獲入官。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, on retrospective review of the Shuozhou attack, he was charged with crossing the border to raid and failing to reach the rendezvous on time; his captives were confiscated for the state treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward a post-campaign review found that during the Shuozhou attack he had raided beyond his assigned bounds and missed the rendezvous; his captives were seized for the public account.

sentences.zh: 九年，授巴牙喇纛章京，從貝勒多鐸等伐明。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed Baturu Banner Commander and followed Prince Dodo and others in attacking Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was made Baturu Banner Commander and joined Prince Dodo and others on a Ming campaign.

sentences.zh: 多鐸既入廣寧，令圖賴與固山額真阿山等以四百人為前鋒向錦州，擊殺明將劉應選，破其軍。

translations.literal: After Dodo entered Guangning, he ordered Tu Lai and Gushan Ejen Ashan and others to take four hundred men as vanguard toward Jinzhou, where they killed the Ming general Liu Yingxuan and routed his army.
translations.idiomatic: Once Dodo had entered Guangning, he sent Tu Lai and Gushan Ejen Ashan with four hundred men as vanguard toward Jinzhou, where they killed the Ming general Liu Yingxuan and shattered his force.

sentences.zh: 師還，以功得優賚。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he received special rewards for merit.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he received an exceptional reward for his service.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，授議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde he was appointed a Deliberative Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 he was appointed Deliberative Minister.

sentences.zh: 三年，上命睿親王多爾袞、貝勒岳託率師分道伐明。

translations.literal: In the third year the emperor ordered Prince Regent Dorgon and Prince Yueto to lead armies by separate routes against Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the emperor ordered Prince Regent Dorgon and Prince Yueto to lead separate columns against Ming.

sentences.zh: 圖賴從岳託為前驅，踰牆子嶺入邊，克十一台，遂南略山東。

translations.literal: Tu Lai followed Yueto as vanguard, crossed over the Ziwuling Pass into the frontier, captured eleven beacon towers, and then swept south through Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Lai served under Yueto as vanguard, crossed the Ziwuling Pass into Ming territory, took eleven beacon towers, and then drove south through Shandong.

sentences.zh: 明將以八千人拒戰，蒙古阿藍泰旁卻，圖賴方督所部馳擊，敵百騎突至，圖賴搏戰陷堅，敵敗去。

translations.literal: A Ming general opposed him with eight thousand men. The Mongol Arantai hung back on the flank. Tu Lai was just directing his troops in a charge when a hundred enemy horsemen suddenly broke in. Tu Lai fought hand to hand in the thick of it, and the enemy were defeated and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: A Ming commander met him with eight thousand troops while the Mongol Arantai hung back on the flank. As Tu Lai was leading a charge, a hundred enemy horsemen burst in on him. He fought through the press at close quarters until the enemy broke and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 明大學士劉宇亮綴我師而北至通州，圖賴與固山額真譚泰擊破之，拔四城，進三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: The Ming Grand Secretary Liu Yuliang followed our army north as far as Tongzhou. Tu Lai and Gushan Ejen Tan Tai defeated him, captured four cities, and he was promoted to third-rank Meire Commander.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Grand Secretary Liu Yuliang trailed our army north to Tongzhou. Tu Lai and Gushan Ejen Tan Tai routed him, took four cities, and Tu Lai was promoted to third-rank Meire Commander.

sentences.zh: 六年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗等伐明，圍錦州。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Prince Jirhalang and others in attacking Ming and besieging Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined Prince Jirhalang and others on a Ming campaign and helped besiege Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 明總兵祖大壽為明守，蒙古吳巴什、諾木齊等謀內應，事泄，大壽以兵攻吳巴什等，圖賴入其郛，力戰，援諾木齊出。

translations.literal: The Ming commander Zu Dashou held the city for Ming. The Mongols Ubashi and Nomuchi plotted to defect from within, but the affair was exposed and Dashou attacked Ubashi and the others. Tu Lai entered their outer enclosure, fought fiercely, and rescued Nomuchi.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming commander Zu Dashou held Jinzhou for Ming. The Mongols Ubashi and Nomuchi plotted to open the gates from within, but the plot leaked and Dashou attacked them. Tu Lai fought his way into their outer camp, battled fiercely, and brought Nomuchi out safely.

sentences.zh: 先後破杏山、松山援兵，遂督烏真超哈拔塔山、杏山二城，進一等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: He successively defeated the relief forces of Xingshan and Songshan, then directed the artillery in capturing the two cities of Tashan and Xingshan, and was promoted to first-rank Meire Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated the relief armies from Xingshan and Songshan in turn, then directed the gunners in taking Tashan and Xingshan and was promoted to first-rank Meire Commander.

sentences.zh: 師還，追論攻錦州時巴牙喇兵有怯退者，圖賴當罰鍰，上命寬之。

translations.literal: When the army returned, on retrospective review of the Jinzhou campaign some Baturu troops were found to have retreated in fear. Tu Lai was liable to a fine, but the emperor ordered leniency.
translations.idiomatic: After the army returned, a review of the Jinzhou campaign found that some Baturu troops had fallen back in fear. Tu Lai was due a fine, but the emperor ordered it waived.

sentences.zh: 八年，從伐明，拔中後所、前屯衛，進三等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed in attacking Ming, captured Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei, and was promoted to third-rank Angbang Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined the Ming campaign, took Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei, and was promoted to third-rank Angbang Commander.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從睿親王多爾袞帥師伐明，明將吳三桂迎師。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed Prince Regent Dorgon in leading troops against Ming, and the Ming general Wu Sangui welcomed the army.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he marched with Prince Regent Dorgon against Ming, where the Ming general Wu Sangui received their army.

sentences.zh: 四月戊寅，師距山海關十里，李自成遣其將唐通率數百騎出關，是夕遇於一片石，圖賴督巴牙喇兵與戰，通敗走。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin of the fourth month the army halted ten li from Shanhaiguan. Li Zicheng sent his general Tang Tong with several hundred horsemen out of the pass. That night they met at Yipianshi. Tu Lai directed the Baturu troops in battle, and Tong was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day in the fourth month the army camped ten li from Shanhaiguan. Li Zicheng sent his general Tang Tong out of the pass with several hundred cavalry. That night they clashed at Yipianshi. Tu Lai led the Baturu troops into the fight and drove Tang Tong off in defeat.

sentences.zh: 己卯，入關，從大軍擊破自成。

translations.literal: On the day jimao they entered the pass and followed the main army in defeating Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day they crossed the pass and joined the main army in defeating Li Zicheng.

sentences.zh: 自成還京師西遁，圖賴復從諸軍追擊，敗之於慶都。

translations.literal: Zicheng returned to the capital and fled west. Tu Lai again followed the armies in pursuit and defeated him at Qingdu.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng withdrew to the capital and fled west. Tu Lai joined the pursuit again and routed him at Qingdu.

sentences.zh: 二年，敘功，超授三等公。

translations.literal: In the second year, on review of merit, he was specially promoted to third-rank duke.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year his service was recognized with an exceptional promotion to third-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 時圖賴方從定國大將軍豫親王多鐸西討自成，豫親王師自懷慶而南，圖賴至孟津，率精兵渡河，明守將黃士欣等皆走，降瀕河寨堡十五。

translations.literal: At that time Tu Lai was following the Pacification General Prince Dodo in the western campaign against Zicheng. Dodo's army moved south from Huaiqing, while Tu Lai reached Mengjin, led picked troops across the river, and the Ming defenders Huang Shixin and others all fled; fifteen riverside forts surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Lai was then serving under Pacification General Prince Dodo in the western campaign against Li Zicheng. While Dodo marched south from Huaiqing, Tu Lai reached Mengjin, crossed the river with elite troops, and put the Ming defenders Huang Shixin and others to flight; fifteen riverside forts submitted.

sentences.zh: 明總兵許定國等以所部來附，進薄潼關。

translations.literal: The Ming commander Xu Dingguo and others came over with their troops, and the army pressed close to Tongguan.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming commander Xu Dingguo and others defected with their forces, and the army advanced to Tongguan.

sentences.zh: 自成將劉宗閔據山為陣拒我師。

translations.literal: Zicheng's general Liu Zongmin took position on the hills in battle array to oppose our army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng's general Liu Zongmin drew up on the hills to block our advance.

sentences.zh: 噶布什賢章京努山、鄂碩等率兵向敵，敵迎戰，圖賴率百四十騎直前掩殺，一以當百，俘馘過半。

translations.literal: Gabsihiyan Commander Nushan, Eshuo, and others led troops against the enemy, who came out to meet them. Tu Lai led one hundred forty horsemen straight forward in a killing charge, each man worth a hundred; more than half the enemy were captured or killed.
translations.idiomatic: Gabsihiyan Commanders Nushan, Eshuo, and others advanced on the enemy, who came out to fight. Tu Lai charged forward with one hundred forty horsemen, each fighting as if he were a hundred, and took more than half the foe prisoner or dead.

sentences.zh: 是歲正月，自成將劉方亮以千餘人出關覘我師，圖賴與阿濟格尼堪等令正黃、正紅、鑲白、鑲紅、鑲藍等五旗各牛錄出巴牙喇兵，率以擊敵，大敗之。

translations.literal: In the first month of that year Zicheng's general Liu Fangliang came out of the pass with more than a thousand men to reconnoiter our army. Tu Lai and Aji Ge Nikan and others ordered each company of the Plain Yellow, Plain Red, Bordered White, Bordered Red, and Bordered Blue banners to send out Baturu troops, led them against the enemy, and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of that year Li Zicheng's general Liu Fangliang came through the pass with over a thousand men to scout our forces. Tu Lai and Aji Ge Nikan ordered each company of the Plain Yellow, Plain Red, Bordered White, Bordered Red, and Bordered Blue banners to commit Baturu troops, led them into battle, and routed the enemy.

sentences.zh: 自成聞敗，親率馬步兵拒戰，又徵鑲黃、正藍、正白三旗兵相助，賊連夕攻我壘，皆敗走，遂破潼關。

translations.literal: On hearing of the defeat, Zicheng personally led horse and foot to resist. He also called up troops of the Bordered Yellow, Plain Blue, and Plain White banners to assist. The rebels attacked our encampments night after night but were each time defeated and driven off, and Tongguan was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Zicheng heard of the defeat he came in person with cavalry and infantry to resist, and called in reinforcements from the Bordered Yellow, Plain Blue, and Plain White banners. The rebels assaulted our camps night after night but were beaten back each time, and Tongguan fell.

sentences.zh: 陝西既定，豫親王移師下江南。

translations.literal: Once Shaanxi was settled, Prince Dodo shifted his army south to the lower Yangtze region.
translations.idiomatic: After Shaanxi was secured, Prince Dodo turned his army south toward Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 四月，至揚州，令圖賴與拜音圖、阿山等攻之，克其城，執明大學士史可法殺之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month they reached Yangzhou. He ordered Tu Lai, Baiyintu, Ashan, and others to attack it, captured the city, seized the Ming Grand Secretary Shi Kefa, and put him to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the army reached Yangzhou. Dodo ordered Tu Lai, Baiyintu, Ashan, and others to assault the city, took it, seized the Ming Grand Secretary Shi Kefa, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 進攻明南京，復令圖賴與拜音圖、阿山率舟師列江西岸助攻。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack the Ming Southern Capital, he again ordered Tu Lai, Baiyintu, and Ashan to lead a fleet drawn up on the west bank of the river to assist the assault.
translations.idiomatic: When the army moved on the Ming Southern Capital, he again assigned Tu Lai, Baiyintu, and Ashan to line the fleet along the west bank of the river and support the attack.

sentences.zh: 南京既下，從貝勒尼堪等逐明福王至蕪湖。

translations.literal: After the Southern Capital fell, he followed Prince Nikan and others in pursuing the Ming Prince of Fu to Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: After Nanjing fell, he joined Prince Nikan and others in chasing the Ming Prince of Fu to Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 福王登舟，將渡江，圖賴扼江斷渡，明將田雄、馬得功以福王降。

translations.literal: The Prince of Fu boarded a boat intending to cross the river. Tu Lai held the river and cut off the crossing. The Ming generals Tian Xiong and Ma Degong surrendered the Prince of Fu.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Fu went aboard a boat to cross the Yangtze. Tu Lai sealed the river and blocked the crossing, after which the Ming generals Tian Xiong and Ma Degong handed the prince over.

sentences.zh: 師還，圖賴上書攝政睿親王，略言：「圖賴昔年事太宗，王之所知也。

translations.literal: When the army returned, Tu Lai submitted a memorial to the regent Prince Dorgon, saying in summary: "In former years Tu Lai served Taizong — this Your Highness knows.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return Tu Lai wrote to Regent Prince Dorgon, saying in substance: "Your Highness knows how I served Taizong in earlier years.

sentences.zh: 今圖賴事上，亦猶昔事太宗時。

translations.literal: Now in serving the emperor, Tu Lai is the same as in serving Taizong then.
translations.idiomatic: In serving the throne now I am the same man I was when I served Taizong.

sentences.zh: 不避諸王貝勒嫌怨，見有異心，不為容默；

translations.literal: I do not shun the resentment of princes and beiles; when I see disloyal intent I do not keep silent;
translations.idiomatic: I do not shrink from princes' displeasure; when I see disloyalty I will not hold my tongue;

sentences.zh: 大臣以下、牛錄章京以上，亦不為隱惡。

translations.literal: nor do I conceal wrongdoing in anyone from Grand Ministers down to Company Commanders and above.
translations.idiomatic: nor do I cover wrongdoing in anyone from grand ministers down to company commanders.

sentences.zh: 圖賴誓於天，必盡忠事上。

translations.literal: Tu Lai swears before Heaven that he will serve the emperor with full loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: I swear before Heaven to serve the throne with my whole loyalty.

sentences.zh: 圖賴有過失，王若不言，恐不免於罪戾。

translations.literal: If Tu Lai has faults and Your Highness does not speak of them, I fear I shall not escape guilt.
translations.idiomatic: If I err and Your Highness says nothing, I fear I shall still be punished.

sentences.zh: 王幸毋姑息，不我教誡也！

translations.literal: I beg Your Highness not to indulge me and fail to instruct me!
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Highness not to spare me correction!

sentences.zh: 初，圖賴在軍，固山額真譚泰方從英親王阿濟格西征，遣使告圖賴曰：「我軍道迂險，故後至。

translations.literal: Earlier, while Tu Lai was in the field, Gushan Ejen Tan Tai was following Prince Ajige on the western campaign and sent a messenger to tell Tu Lai: "Our army took a roundabout and difficult route, so we arrived late.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, while Tu Lai was still with the army, Gushan Ejen Tan Tai was on Prince Ajige's western campaign and sent word to Tu Lai: "Our column took a roundabout and difficult route, so we arrived late.

sentences.zh: 請留南京畀我軍取之。

translations.literal: Please leave Nanjing for our army to take."
translations.idiomatic: Please leave Nanjing for us to capture."

sentences.zh: 」圖賴以其語告豫親王，別作書遣塞爾特報索尼，將使索尼啟攝政王。

translations.literal: Tu Lai reported his words to Prince Dodo and separately wrote a letter, sending Serter to inform Sony, intending that Sony should report to the regent.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Lai reported this to Prince Dodo and also wrote a separate letter, sending Serter to inform Sony so that Sony could bring the matter to the regent.

sentences.zh: 塞爾特以書示牛錄希思翰，希思翰慮書達，譚泰且得罪，令沉諸河。

translations.literal: Serter showed the letter to Company Commander Sihan. Sihan feared that if the letter reached its destination Tan Tai would be punished and ordered it sunk in the river.
translations.idiomatic: Serter showed the letter to Company Commander Sihan, who feared that if it reached Sony, Tan Tai would be punished, and had it thrown into the river.

sentences.zh: 圖賴至京師，系塞爾特索前書，塞爾特詭言已達索尼。

translations.literal: When Tu Lai reached the capital he detained Serter and demanded the earlier letter. Serter falsely claimed it had already reached Sony.
translations.idiomatic: When Tu Lai reached the capital he seized Serter and demanded the letter back. Serter falsely claimed it had already been delivered to Sony.

sentences.zh: 事聞於攝政王。

translations.literal: The affair came to the regent's ears.
translations.idiomatic: The matter reached the regent.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，下諸大臣審勘，將罪索尼。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year the case was referred to the grand ministers for investigation, and Sony was to be punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year the grand ministers were ordered to investigate, and Sony was to be held guilty.

sentences.zh: 攝政王親鞫塞爾特，始自承沉書狀。

translations.literal: The regent personally interrogated Serter, who then confessed to having sunk the letter.
translations.idiomatic: The regent questioned Serter in person, and he finally admitted that he had sunk the letter.

sentences.zh: 攝政王坐午門議譚泰罪，三日猶未決。

translations.literal: The regent sat at the Meridian Gate to deliberate Tan Tai's guilt, but after three days no decision had been reached.
translations.idiomatic: The regent held court at the Meridian Gate to judge Tan Tai's case, yet after three days still could not reach a verdict.

sentences.zh: 圖賴詰王，語甚厲，攝政王怒曰：「爾亦過妄矣！

translations.literal: Tu Lai pressed the prince in harsh language. The regent said in anger: "You too go too far!
translations.idiomatic: Tu Lai pressed the regent in harsh terms. The regent said angrily, "You go too far yourself!

sentences.zh: 曩逐流賊至慶都，議分道進兵。

translations.literal: When we once pursued the bandits to Qingdu and debated dividing the army to advance by separate routes,
translations.idiomatic: When we once pursued the rebels to Qingdu and debated splitting the army to advance by separate routes,

sentences.zh: 因諸將爭先，爾誚讓肅、豫、英諸親王，不顧而唾。

translations.literal: because the generals vied to go first you rebuked the Princes of Su, Yu, and Ying and spat without regard.
translations.idiomatic: because the commanders vied to go first you rebuked the Su, Yu, and Ying princes and even spat in contempt.

sentences.zh: 今又以語凌我。

translations.literal: Now you use words to insult me as well.
translations.idiomatic: Now you speak to me in the same overbearing way.

sentences.zh: 似此怒色疾聲，將逞威於誰乎？

translations.literal: With such angry looks and sharp tones, on whom do you mean to show your power?
translations.idiomatic: With that angry face and sharp voice, on whom do you mean to throw your weight?

sentences.zh: 予與諸王非先帝子弟乎！

translations.literal: Are not I and the princes the late emperor's own sons and brothers!
translations.idiomatic: Are the princes and I not the late emperor's own sons and brothers!

sentences.zh: 」語畢，遂還邸。

translations.literal: " When he had finished speaking he returned to his residence.
translations.idiomatic: " With that he withdrew to his residence.

sentences.zh: 諸王因執圖賴將罪之，王復返曰：「圖賴雖聲色過厲，然非退有後言者。

translations.literal: The princes thereupon seized Tu Lai to punish him, but the prince returned and said: "Although Tu Lai's tone and manner were excessive, he is not one who speaks ill behind others' backs.
translations.idiomatic: The princes then seized Tu Lai to punish him, but the regent came back and said, "Tu Lai was harsh in manner, but he is not the sort to speak ill of others behind their backs.

sentences.zh: 且為我矢勤效忠，無他咎也。

translations.literal: Moreover he has sworn to serve me with tireless loyalty and has no other fault."
translations.idiomatic: He has sworn to serve me faithfully, and has no other fault."

sentences.zh: 」命解其縛。

translations.literal: He ordered his bonds removed.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered him untied.

sentences.zh: 獄既定，侍衛阿里馬私誚圖賴庇索尼，圖賴以告攝政王，王令捕阿里馬及其二弟索泥岱、鎖寧。

translations.literal: Once the case was settled, the guardsman Alima privately mocked Tu Lai for shielding Sony. Tu Lai reported this to the regent, who ordered Alima and his two younger brothers Sonidai and Suoning arrested.
translations.idiomatic: After the trial was concluded, the guardsman Alima privately mocked Tu Lai for protecting Sony. Tu Lai reported this to the regent, who ordered the arrest of Alima and his younger brothers Sonidai and Suoning.

sentences.zh: 阿里馬故驍勇，與索泥岱拔刀力拒。

translations.literal: Alima was by nature fierce and brave; he and Sonidai drew their swords and resisted with force.
translations.idiomatic: Alima was a seasoned fighter; he and Sonidai drew their swords and resisted violently.

sentences.zh: 皆殺之，而釋鎖寧。

translations.literal: Both were killed, while Suoning was released.
translations.idiomatic: Both were killed, but Suoning was released.

sentences.zh: 尋授本旗固山額真。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Gushan Ejen of his own banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Gushan Ejen of his banner.

sentences.zh: 二月，以貝勒博洛為征南大將軍，圖賴副之，帥師徇浙江、福建。

translations.literal: In the second month Prince Bolo was made Pacification General of the South, with Tu Lai as his deputy, to lead troops in subduing Zhejiang and Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Prince Bolo was appointed Pacification General of the South with Tu Lai as deputy to lead the conquest of Zhejiang and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 五月，論破流賊及定河南、江南功，進圖賴一等公。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on review of merit for defeating the bandits and pacifying Henan and Jiangnan, Tu Lai was promoted to first-rank duke.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month his service in defeating the rebels and securing Henan and Jiangnan was recognized with promotion to first-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 是月，師至杭州，明魯王駐紹興，其將方國安等屯錢塘江東岸，綿亙二百里，艤舟拒我軍。

translations.literal: That month the army reached Hangzhou. The Ming Prince of Lu was at Shaoxing, and his generals Fang Guo'an and others encamped on the east bank of the Qiantang River for two hundred li, mooring boats to block our army.
translations.idiomatic: That month the army reached Hangzhou. The Ming Prince of Lu held Shaoxing while his generals Fang Guo'an and others lined the east bank of the Qiantang for two hundred li with boats drawn up to block our advance.

sentences.zh: 我軍舟未具，會潮落沙漲，圖賴率諸將士策馬自上流迳渡，江廣十餘裡，人馬無溺者。

translations.literal: Our fleet was not yet ready, but the tide fell and the sandbars rose. Tu Lai led the officers and men on horseback straight across from upstream; the river was more than ten li wide, yet neither man nor horse was drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Our boats were not yet ready, but as the tide fell and the sandbars rose Tu Lai led officers and men on horseback straight across from upstream. The river was more than ten li wide, yet not a man or horse was lost.

sentences.zh: 國安望見，驚，棄戰艦走還紹興，將劫魯王以降，魯王走台州，圖賴師從之，獲其將武景科等。

translations.literal: Guo'an saw them and was alarmed; he abandoned his warships and fled back to Shaoxing, intending to seize the Prince of Lu to surrender. The prince fled to Taizhou. Tu Lai's army followed and captured his generals Wu Jingke and others.
translations.idiomatic: Guo'an saw them and panicked, abandoned his warships, and fled to Shaoxing, planning to seize the Prince of Lu and surrender. The prince fled to Taizhou. Tu Lai pursued and captured his generals Wu Jingke and others.

sentences.zh: 進克金華，殺明督師大學士硃大典。

translations.literal: Advancing, they captured Jinhua and killed the Ming supervising minister and Grand Secretary Zhu Dadian.
translations.idiomatic: They advanced and took Jinhua, killing the Ming supervising minister and Grand Secretary Zhu Dadian.

sentences.zh: 七月，復進克衢州，殺明蜀王盛濃及明將吳凱、項鳴斯等。

translations.literal: In the seventh month they again advanced and captured Quzhou, killing the Ming Prince of Shu Sheng Nong and the Ming generals Wu Kai, Xiang Mingsi, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month they took Quzhou as well, killing the Ming Prince of Shu Sheng Nong and the generals Wu Kai, Xiang Mingsi, and others.

sentences.zh: 浙江平。

translations.literal: Zhejiang was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang was pacified.

sentences.zh: 八月，博洛令諸軍分道入福建，圖賴自衢州出仙霞關，擊破明大學士黃鳴駿等。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Bolo ordered the armies to enter Fujian by separate routes. Tu Lai marched out from Quzhou through Xianxia Pass and defeated the Ming Grand Secretary Huang Mingjun and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Bolo sent the armies into Fujian by separate routes. Tu Lai marched from Quzhou through Xianxia Pass and defeated the Ming Grand Secretary Huang Mingjun and others.

sentences.zh: 師度嶺，克浦城，分遣署巴牙喇纛章京杜爾德、噶布什賢章京拜尹岱等攻克建寧、延平諸府。

translations.literal: The army crossed the mountains, captured Pucheng, and detached Acting Baturu Banner Commander Durde, Gabsihiyan Commander Baiyindai, and others to capture the prefectures of Jianning, Yanping, and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: The army crossed the pass, took Pucheng, and detached Acting Baturu Banner Commander Durde, Gabsihiyan Commander Baiyindai, and others to seize Jianning, Yanping, and the other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 明唐王自延平走汀州，復遣巴牙喇纛章京阿濟格尼堪、杜爾德等帥師追擊，克其城，執唐王及其宗室諸王送福州。

translations.literal: The Ming Prince of Tang fled from Yanping to Tingzhou. They again sent Baturu Banner Commander Aji Ge Nikan, Durde, and others to pursue, captured the city, seized the Prince of Tang and the princes of the imperial clan, and sent them to Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Prince of Tang fled from Yanping to Tingzhou. Baturu Banner Commander Aji Ge Nikan, Durde, and others were sent in pursuit, took the city, seized the Prince of Tang and the imperial clan princes, and sent them to Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 明將薑正希以二萬人夜襲汀州，已登陴，我軍出禦，擊殺過半；

translations.literal: The Ming general Jiang Zhengxi made a night assault on Tingzhou with twenty thousand men and had already mounted the walls when our army went out to meet them and killed more than half;
translations.idiomatic: The Ming general Jiang Zhengxi raided Tingzhou at night with twenty thousand men and had already gained the walls when our troops sallied forth and killed more than half his force;

sentences.zh: 別軍自廣信出分水關，克崇安。

translations.literal: another column marched out from Guangxin through Fenshui Pass and captured Chong'an.
translations.idiomatic: another column marched from Guangxin through Fenshui Pass and took Chong'an.

sentences.zh: 共撫定興化、漳州、泉州諸府。

translations.literal: Together they pacified the prefectures of Xinghua, Zhangzhou, Quanzhou, and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Together they pacified Xinghua, Zhangzhou, Quanzhou, and the other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 福建平。

translations.literal: Fujian was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian was pacified.

sentences.zh: 師還，至金華，圖賴卒於軍。

translations.literal: When the army returned and reached Jinhua, Tu Lai died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march, at Jinhua, Tu Lai died in camp.

sentences.zh: 子輝塞，襲爵。

translations.literal: His son Huise inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Huise inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 貝子屯齊等訐鄭親王濟爾哈朗，因及圖賴嘗謀立肅親王豪格，及上即位，复附和鄭親王，輝塞坐奪爵。

translations.literal: Prince Tunqi and others denounced Prince Jirhalang and, in the process, implicated Tu Lai in having once plotted to install Prince Su Hooge. When the emperor took the throne, Huise was again found to have sided with Prince Jirhalang, and his title was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Tunqi and others denounced Prince Jirhalang and, in doing so, implicated Tu Lai in an earlier plot to make Prince Su Hooge emperor. After the emperor assumed personal rule, Huise was found to have sided again with Prince Jirhalang and lost his title.

sentences.zh: 八年，上親政，念圖賴舊功，命配享太廟，諡昭勳，立碑紀績，輝塞复襲爵。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, when the emperor took personal rule, remembering Tu Lai's old service he ordered him enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, granted the posthumous title Zhaoxun, erected a stele recording his achievements, and Huise again inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, when the emperor assumed personal rule, he honored Tu Lai's long service by ordering his spirit tablet placed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, granting the posthumous title Zhaoxun, erecting a stele to his deeds, and restoring Huise to the title.

sentences.zh: 雍正九年三月，定封一等雄勇公。

translations.literal: In the third month of the ninth year of Yongzheng the fief was fixed as first-rank Valiant Duke.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yongzheng 9 the line was fixed as first-rank Valiant Duke.

sentences.zh: =準塔=準塔，滿洲正白旗人，扈爾漢第四子也。

translations.literal: Zhun Ta — Zhun Ta was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and the fourth son of Hurhan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhun Ta was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and the fourth son of Hurhan.

sentences.zh: 天聰間，授世職牛錄章京，官甲喇額真。

translations.literal: During the Tiancong period he was granted the hereditary rank of Company Commander and served as Jalan Ejen.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tiancong reign he received the hereditary rank of Company Commander and held the post of Jalan Ejen.

sentences.zh: 嘗與鰲拜共率師略明錦州，復與勞薩共率師迎護察哈爾來降諸宰桑。

translations.literal: He once led troops with Oboi to raid Ming Jinzhou, and again with Laosa to escort the zaisang of the surrendering Chahar.
translations.idiomatic: He once joined Oboi in raiding Ming Jinzhou, and later with Laosa in escorting the Chahar zaisang who came over to the Qing side.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年四月，從武英郡王阿濟格攻明皮島，敵守堅。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Chongde he followed Prince Ajige of Wuying in attacking Ming Pi Island, where the enemy defended stubbornly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Chongde 2 he followed Prince Ajige of Wuying against Ming Pi Island, where the defenders held firm.

sentences.zh: 阿濟格集諸將問策，準塔與鰲拜對曰：「我二人誓必克之！

translations.literal: Ajige assembled the generals to ask for plans. Zhun Ta and Oboi replied: "The two of us swear we shall take it!
translations.idiomatic: Ajige called the generals together for counsel. Zhun Ta and Oboi answered, "We two swear we shall take it!

sentences.zh: 不克，不復見王。

translations.literal: If we fail, we shall not again appear before the prince."
translations.idiomatic: If we fail, we shall not face Your Highness again."

sentences.zh: 」遂先眾連舟渡海，舉火招諸軍，敵倚堡為陣以拒，與鰲拜犯矢石力戰，卒取其島。

translations.literal: They then went ahead of the host, linked boats to cross the sea, and raised fires to summon the army. The enemy relied on their fort in battle array to resist. With Oboi they braved arrows and stones and fought fiercely, and in the end took the island.
translations.idiomatic: They then went ahead of the army, lashed boats together to cross the sea, and lit signal fires to bring up the main force. The enemy drew up behind their fort to resist. Zhun Ta and Oboi fought through shot and stone and at last took the island.

sentences.zh: 論功，進世職三等梅勒章京，襲十二次，賜號「巴圖魯」，敕增紀其績。

translations.literal: On review of merit he was promoted to third-rank hereditary Meire Commander with twelve successive inheritances, granted the title "Baturu," and ordered that his deeds be added to the record.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was promoted to third-rank hereditary Meire Commander for twelve inheritances, granted the title Baturu, and ordered that his deeds be entered in the annals.

sentences.zh: 三年八月，授蒙古固山額真。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year he was appointed Mongol Gushan Ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year he was made Mongol Gushan Ejen.

sentences.zh: 九月，從揚武大將軍貝勒岳託等伐明，攻密雲牆子嶺，準塔先據嶺，導諸軍毀邊牆以入，擊敗明太監馮永盛、總兵侯世祿等；

translations.literal: In the ninth month he followed the Grand Martial General Prince Yueto and others in attacking Ming at Miyun's Ziwuling Pass. Zhun Ta seized the pass first, guided the army in breaking through the border wall to enter, and defeated the Ming eunuch Feng Yongsheng, Commander Hou Shilu, and others;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he joined Grand Martial General Prince Yueto against Ming at Miyun's Ziwuling Pass. Zhun Ta seized the heights first, led the army through a breach in the border wall, and routed the Ming eunuch Feng Yongsheng, Commander Hou Shilu, and others;

sentences.zh: 又與武賴敗三屯營援兵，復進戰於董家口，破敵，行略地，克城二。

translations.literal: he again with Wulai defeated the relief force from Santunying, advanced again to fight at Dongjiakou, routed the enemy, raided the countryside, and captured two cities.
translations.idiomatic: then with Wulai defeated the Santunying relief force, fought again at Dongjiakou, routed the enemy, swept the countryside, and took two cities.

sentences.zh: 師還，進世職二等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was promoted to second-rank hereditary Meire Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was promoted to second-rank hereditary Meire Commander.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，從睿親王多爾袞攻錦州，以阿王指，遣士卒歸，又離城遠駐，議罪，當奪官籍沒，上命罰鍰以贖。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year he followed Prince Regent Dorgon in attacking Jinzhou. On a prince's accusation he sent troops back and also encamped far from the city. On deliberation of guilt he was liable to deprivation of office and confiscation of property, but the emperor ordered a fine in redemption.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year he joined Prince Regent Dorgon at Jinzhou. Accused by a prince of sending troops home and camping too far from the city, he was due to lose his office and property, but the emperor ordered a fine instead.

sentences.zh: 八月，上自將攻錦州，九月，還盛京，命準塔從貝勒杜度等為長圍困之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the emperor led the attack on Jinzhou in person. In the ninth month he returned to Mukden and ordered Zhun Ta to follow Prince Dudu and others in maintaining the long siege.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the emperor led the Jinzhou campaign in person. In the ninth month he returned to Mukden and ordered Zhun Ta to join Prince Dudu and others in the long siege.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，錦州既下，上命貝勒阿巴泰率師留戍。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year, after Jinzhou fell, the emperor ordered Prince Abatai to lead troops in garrisoning it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year, after Jinzhou fell, the emperor left Prince Abatai to garrison the city.

sentences.zh: 旋令準塔與固山額真葉臣等番代。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Zhun Ta was ordered to relieve Gushan Ejen Yechen and others in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhun Ta was soon ordered to relieve Gushan Ejen Yechen and others in rotation.

sentences.zh: 先是圍錦州時，城兵出犯鑲黃旗汛地，巴牙喇兵退入壕內，王貝勒等袒不舉，準塔坐阿附，議罪當罰鍰，上命貸之。

translations.literal: Earlier, during the siege of Jinzhou, garrison troops came out and attacked the Bordered Yellow Banner's sector. The Baturu troops withdrew into the moat. Princes and beiles bared their shoulders but did not report the offense. Zhun Ta was charged with currying favor. On deliberation he was liable to a fine, but the emperor ordered it remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, during the Jinzhou siege, garrison troops raided the Bordered Yellow Banner sector and the Baturu troops fell back into the moat. Princes and beiles went through the ritual of reporting fault but did not actually do so. Zhun Ta was charged with currying favor and was due a fine, but the emperor waived it.

sentences.zh: 十月，從阿巴泰、圖爾格帥師伐明，略山東，與葉克書等分兵攻孟家台，不克，士卒有死者，準塔又妄稱嘗陷陣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he followed Abatai and Turgut in leading troops against Ming and raiding Shandong. With Yekeshu and others he divided forces to attack Mengjiatai but failed to take it; some soldiers died, and Zhun Ta also falsely claimed he had once charged into the enemy line.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he joined Abatai and Turgut on a Ming campaign through Shandong. He and Yekeshu split forces to attack Mengjiatai but failed, with casualties, and Zhun Ta falsely claimed he had fought in the front ranks.

sentences.zh: 師還，議罪，奪巴圖魯號，降世職一等甲喇章京，仍罰鍰。

translations.literal: When the army returned, on deliberation of guilt his Baturu title was revoked, his hereditary rank reduced to first-rank Jalan Commander, and he was still fined.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was judged guilty: his Baturu title was stripped, his rank reduced to first-rank hereditary Jalan Commander, and he was fined again.

sentences.zh: 十二月，復命鎮錦州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was again ordered to garrison Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was again assigned to garrison Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從睿親王多爾袞入關擊李自成，遂至慶都，大破之；

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed Prince Regent Dorgon through the pass to attack Li Zicheng, reached Qingdu, and inflicted a great defeat;
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he crossed the pass with Prince Regent Dorgon against Li Zicheng, reached Qingdu, and routed him;

sentences.zh: 又與譚泰等率噶布什賢兵逐至真定，又破之。

translations.literal: and again with Tan Tai and others led Gabsihiyan troops in pursuit to Zhending and defeated him there as well.
translations.idiomatic: then with Tan Tai and others pursued with Gabsihiyan troops to Zhending and defeated him again.

sentences.zh: 自成焚輜重，倉皇西走，於是京師以北、居庸關內外諸城堡，及畿南諸州縣悉定。

translations.literal: Zicheng burned his baggage train and fled west in panic. Thereupon all the forts north of the capital and inside and outside Juyong Pass, and all the prefectures and counties south of the capital region, were settled.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng burned his baggage and fled west in disarray. The forts north of the capital and on both sides of Juyong Pass, and the counties south of the capital, were all secured.

sentences.zh: 論功，復三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: On review of merit he was restored to third-rank Meire Commander.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was restored to third-rank Meire Commander.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，以饒餘郡王阿巴泰為帥，準塔將左翼，譚布將右翼，帥師徇山東。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year Prince Raoyu Abatai was made commander, with Zhun Ta leading the left wing and Tanbu the right, to subdue Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year Prince Raoyu Abatai was appointed commander, with Zhun Ta on the left wing and Tanbu on the right, to campaign through Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二月，聞明福王遣兵渡河，阿巴泰令準塔等迎戰。

translations.literal: In the second month, hearing that the Ming Prince of Fu had sent troops across the river, Abatai ordered Zhun Ta and others to meet them in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, learning that the Ming Prince of Fu had sent troops across the river, Abatai ordered Zhun Ta and others to intercept them.

sentences.zh: 明兵方攻沛縣李家樓，馬步二千餘屯徐州，距城十五里，準塔師破其壘，斬其將六，明兵赴河死者無算，遂克徐州。

translations.literal: Ming troops were then attacking Lijialou in Peixian; more than two thousand horse and foot were encamped at Xuzhou fifteen li from the city. Zhun Ta's army stormed their camp, beheaded six of their generals, and countless Ming soldiers died fleeing into the river; Xuzhou was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: Ming forces were attacking Lijialou in Peixian while over two thousand cavalry and infantry camped at Xuzhou fifteen li from the city. Zhun Ta stormed their camp, killed six officers, and drove countless men into the river; Xuzhou fell.

sentences.zh: 五月，復自徐州南下，明總兵劉澤清遣其將高祐以舟師攻宿遷，擊破之，進次清河縣。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he again marched south from Xuzhou. The Ming commander Liu Zeqing sent his general Gao You with a fleet to attack Suqian; they were defeated, and the army advanced to Qinghe County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he marched south again from Xuzhou. Ming Commander Liu Zeqing sent Gao You with a fleet against Suqian; Zhun Ta defeated him and advanced to Qinghe County.

sentences.zh: 黃河自西來，至縣境，淮水及清河皆入焉。

translations.literal: The Yellow River comes from the west to the county border, and the Huai and Qing rivers both enter it there.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River reaches the county from the west, where the Huai and Qing rivers join it.

sentences.zh: 澤清遣其將馬化豹、張思義等將兵四萬、舟千餘，據三水交匯處，連營十里。

translations.literal: Zeqing sent his generals Ma Huabao, Zhang Siyi, and others with forty thousand troops and more than a thousand boats to hold the place where the three rivers meet, with camps stretching ten li.
translations.idiomatic: Zeqing sent Ma Huabao, Zhang Siyi, and others with forty thousand troops and over a thousand boats to hold the triple confluence, their camps stretching ten li.

sentences.zh: 準塔遣梅勒章京康喀賴，游擊范炳、吉天相等率兵渡清河，結營相拒，發砲擊敵舟；

translations.literal: Zhun Ta sent Meire Commander Kangkalai, Guerrilla Colonel Fan Bing, Ji Tianxiang, and others to lead troops across the Qing River, encamp to oppose the enemy, and fire cannon at their boats;
translations.idiomatic: Zhun Ta sent Meire Commander Kangkalai, Guerrilla Colonels Fan Bing and Ji Tianxiang, and others across the Qing River to camp opposite the enemy and shell their boats;

sentences.zh: 復遣都司楚進功將步兵六百人屯黃河北岸，鳴砲相應；

translations.literal: he again sent Brigade Commander Chu Jingong with six hundred foot soldiers to encamp on the north bank of the Yellow River and answer with cannon fire;
translations.idiomatic: he posted Brigade Commander Chu Jingong with six hundred infantry on the north bank of the Yellow River to fire in support;

sentences.zh: 又分其兵為二：一出清河上游，一隔水，擊破明馬步軍；

translations.literal: and again divided his force in two: one column up the Qing River, one across the water, and routed the Ming horse and foot;
translations.idiomatic: and split his force: one column up the Qing River, one across the water, routing the Ming cavalry and infantry;

sentences.zh: 兵復合，逐入淮安界，斬其將三。

translations.literal: the troops reunited, pursued into Huai'an territory, and beheaded three enemy generals.
translations.idiomatic: the columns reunited, pursued into Huai'an, and killed three Ming generals.

sentences.zh: 師次清江浦，澤清引去，明將吏栢永馥、範鳴珂出降，遂克淮安。

translations.literal: The army halted at Qingjiangpu. Zeqing withdrew, and the Ming officers Bai Yongfu and Fan Mingke came out to surrender; Huai'an was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: The army reached Qingjiangpu. Zeqing withdrew, and Ming officers Bai Yongfu and Fan Mingke surrendered; Huai'an fell.

sentences.zh: 明新昌王入海據云台山，糾眾陷興化，準塔遣將擊斬之，通州、如皋、泰興諸城皆下；

translations.literal: The Ming Prince of Xinchang went to sea and held Yuntai Mountain, gathered followers, and seized Xinghua. Zhun Ta sent generals who attacked and beheaded him; Tongzhou, Rugao, Taixing, and other cities all fell;
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Prince of Xinchang took to the sea, held Yuntai Mountain, rallied forces, and seized Xinghua. Zhun Ta sent officers who killed him, and Tongzhou, Rugao, Taixing, and other cities submitted;

sentences.zh: 鳳陽、廬州亦降。

translations.literal: Fengyang and Luzhou also surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Fengyang and Luzhou surrendered as well.

sentences.zh: 凡降明將吏二百十三，得舟五百餘、馬九百餘、橐駝二十五、砲一百二十。

translations.literal: In all two hundred thirteen Ming officers and officials surrendered; they obtained more than five hundred boats, more than nine hundred horses, twenty-five camels, and one hundred twenty cannon.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred thirteen Ming officers and officials surrendered in all; the army took more than five hundred boats, nine hundred horses, twenty-five camels, and one hundred twenty cannon.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，進準塔三等昂邦章京，复巴圖魯號，命以固山額真鎮守廬、鳳、淮陽諸處。

translations.literal: When news of victory arrived, Zhun Ta was promoted to third-rank Angbang Commander, his Baturu title was restored, and he was ordered as Gushan Ejen to garrison Luzhou, Fengyang, Huaiyang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On news of victory Zhun Ta was promoted to third-rank Angbang Commander, his Baturu title restored, and he was made Gushan Ejen to garrison Luzhou, Fengyang, Huaiyang, and the surrounding region.

sentences.zh: 準塔帥師巡行諸州縣，安撫居民，設置官吏。

translations.literal: Zhun Ta led troops on circuit through the prefectures and counties, pacified the inhabitants, and set up officials.
translations.idiomatic: Zhun Ta toured the prefectures and counties, reassured the people, and appointed officials.

sentences.zh: 江、淮間悉定。

translations.literal: The region between the Yangtze and Huai was entirely settled.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangtze–Huai region was fully secured.

sentences.zh: 澤清尋亦以所部降。

translations.literal: Zeqing soon also surrendered with his command.
translations.idiomatic: Zeqing soon surrendered with his troops as well.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，從肅親王豪格帥師徇陝西。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year he followed Prince Su Hooge in leading troops to subdue Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year he joined Prince Su Hooge on the Shaanxi campaign.

sentences.zh: 時叛將賀珍據漢中，武大定、石國璽等分屯徽、階諸州，遙與相應。

translations.literal: At that time the rebel general He Zhen held Hanzhong, while Wu Dading, Shi Guoxi, and others were posted separately in Huizhou, Jiezhou, and other prefectures, coordinating with him from afar.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel He Zhen held Hanzhong while Wu Dading, Shi Guoxi, and others garrisoned Huizhou, Jiezhou, and other prefectures in mutual support.

sentences.zh: 豪格師自西安向漢中，珍走西鄉。

translations.literal: Hooge's army marched from Xi'an toward Hanzhong, and Zhen fled to Xixiang.
translations.idiomatic: Hooge marched from Xi'an toward Hanzhong, and He Zhen fled to Xixiang.

sentences.zh: 七月，令準塔與貝子滿達海等攻大定、國璽等，大定、國璽等以其眾七百人降。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he ordered Zhun Ta and Prince Mandahai and others to attack Wu Dading, Shi Guoxi, and the rest; Dading, Guoxi, and the others surrendered with seven hundred followers.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he ordered Zhun Ta and Prince Mandahai to attack Wu Dading and Shi Guoxi, who surrendered with seven hundred men.

sentences.zh: 十一月，豪格擊張獻忠於西充，準塔指揮諸軍合戰，俘馘甚眾。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Hooge attacked Zhang Xianzhong at Xichong. Zhun Ta directed the armies in combined battle and took a great many prisoners and heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Hooge fought Zhang Xianzhong at Xichong. Zhun Ta directed the combined armies and took a great many prisoners and heads.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，復與貝勒尼堪、貝子滿達海等分兵下遵義、夔州、茂州、榮昌、富順、內江、資陽諸郡縣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year he again with Prince Nikan, Prince Mandahai, and others divided forces to descend on the prefectures and counties of Zunyi, Kuizhou, Maozhou, Rongchang, Fushun, Neijiang, Ziyang, and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year he and Prince Nikan, Prince Mandahai, and others took Zunyi, Kuizhou, Maozhou, Rongchang, Fushun, Neijiang, Ziyang, and the other prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 四川平，師還。

translations.literal: Sichuan was pacified and the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan was pacified and the army returned.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: He soon died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 論功，進世職一等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: On review of merit he was promoted to first-rank hereditary Jingqi Niha.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was posthumously promoted to first-rank hereditary Jingqi Niha.

sentences.zh: 十二年，追諡襄毅，立碑紀績。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was posthumously granted the title Xiangyi and a stele was erected recording his achievements.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he received the posthumous title Xiangyi and a stele was raised to his deeds.

sentences.zh: 準塔無子，弟阿拉密襲。

translations.literal: Zhun Ta had no son; his younger brother Alam inherited.
translations.idiomatic: Zhun Ta had no son; his younger brother Alam inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 遇恩詔，進三等伯。

translations.literal: On an amnesty edict he was promoted to third-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: On an amnesty edict the line was raised to third-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 康熙中，準塔兄子舒書降襲一等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the Kangxi period Zhun Ta's nephew's son Shushu inherited at reduced rank as first-rank Jingqi Niha.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kangxi reign Zhun Ta's grand-nephew Shushu inherited at reduced rank as first-rank Jingqi Niha.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封一等子。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign the fief was fixed as first-rank viscount.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign the line was fixed as first-rank viscount.

sentences.zh: =伊爾德=伊爾德，滿洲正黃旗人，揚古利族侄也。

translations.literal: Yi Erde — Yi Erde was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and a clansman-nephew of Yangguli.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Erde was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and a nephew of Yangguli's clan.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，從揚古利率師入明邊，略錦州、寧遠。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong he followed Yangguli in leading troops into the Ming frontier and raiding Jinzhou and Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 3 he joined Yangguli in raiding the Ming frontier at Jinzhou and Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 既，復從攻北京。

translations.literal: Afterward he again followed in the attack on Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined the attack on Beijing.

sentences.zh: 師還，敗山海關援兵於灤州，出塞為前驅，斬明兵守隘者。

translations.literal: When the army returned he defeated the Shanhaiguan relief force at Luanzhou, went out beyond the pass as vanguard, and beheaded Ming troops guarding the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march he routed the Shanhaiguan relief force at Luanzhou, served as vanguard beyond the pass, and killed Ming troops at the frontier posts.

sentences.zh: 五年，從上圍大凌河城，城兵突出，伊爾德衝鋒殺敵，逐敵迫壕，乃引還。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed the emperor in besieging Dalinhe. The garrison sallied forth; Yi Erde charged and killed the enemy, pursued them to the moat, and then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the siege of Dalinhe. When the garrison sallied out, Yi Erde charged, killed the enemy, pursued them to the moat, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 敵騎挾弓矢將犯御營，伊爾德馳斬之。

translations.literal: Enemy horsemen with bows and arrows were about to attack the imperial camp; Yi Erde galloped up and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy horsemen with bows were about to strike the imperial camp; Yi Erde rode out and cut them down.

sentences.zh: 秋，复略前屯衛，將十五人，捕敵軍邏卒。

translations.literal: In autumn he again raided Qiantunwei with fifteen men and captured enemy scouts on the border.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he raided Qiantunwei again with fifteen men and took enemy border scouts.

sentences.zh: 值別將噶思哈為敵困，奮擊，援之出。

translations.literal: He happened upon Deputy General Gasiha trapped by the enemy, fought fiercely, and rescued him.
translations.idiomatic: He found Deputy General Gasiha surrounded by the enemy, fought through to him, and brought him out.

sentences.zh: 積功，授世職備禦。

translations.literal: For accumulated merit he was granted the hereditary rank of Defender.
translations.idiomatic: For his accumulated service he received the hereditary rank of Defender.

sentences.zh: 尋擢巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: He was soon promoted to Baturu Banner Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made Baturu Banner Commander.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，從貝勒阿巴泰築都爾弼城，將巴牙喇兵四百人護工役。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde he followed Prince Abatai in building Duerbi City and led four hundred Baturu troops to guard the laborers.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 he joined Prince Abatai in building Duerbi City and led four hundred Baturu troops to protect the work crews.

sentences.zh: 五年，從圍錦州，敵出戰，伊爾德領纛追擊，敗之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed in besieging Jinzhou. When the enemy came out to fight, Yi Erde led the banner in pursuit and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the Jinzhou siege. When the enemy sallied out, Yi Erde led the pursuit under the banner and routed them.

sentences.zh: 督屯田錦州、松山間，明人縱牧於野，伊爾德設伏烏欣河，驅其牲畜以歸。

translations.literal: He supervised farming colonies between Jinzhou and Songshan. Ming people let their herds graze in the open country; Yi Erde set an ambush at the Wuxin River and drove off their livestock.
translations.idiomatic: He oversaw garrison farms between Jinzhou and Songshan. When Ming herders grazed their stock in the open, Yi Erde ambushed them at the Wuxin River and drove the animals off.

sentences.zh: 敵襲我軍後，伊爾德還擊，斬獲無算。

translations.literal: When the enemy attacked our rear, Yi Erde turned back to strike and killed and captured beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy struck our rear, Yi Erde wheeled about and killed and captured without number.

sentences.zh: 超進世職三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: He was specially promoted to third-rank hereditary Meire Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He received an exceptional promotion to third-rank hereditary Meire Commander.

sentences.zh: 屢坐事當削世職，命罰鍰以贖。

translations.literal: He repeatedly incurred offenses for which he was liable to lose his hereditary rank, but was ordered to pay fines in redemption.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly found guilty of offenses that should have cost him his hereditary rank, but each time paid a fine instead.

sentences.zh: 七年，復從圍錦州，明兵來奪砲，擊敗之，進一等。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he again followed in besieging Jinzhou. Ming troops came to seize cannon; he defeated them and was promoted to first rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he joined the Jinzhou siege again, defeated Ming troops who came to recover their cannon, and was promoted to first rank.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，命駐防錦州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he was ordered to garrison Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he was assigned to garrison Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 二年，加半個前程。

translations.literal: In the second year he was granted half a rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he received half a step of promotion credit.

sentences.zh: 世祖召伊爾德，命從豫親王多鐸南征，與尚書宗室韓岱等將蒙古兵自南陽下歸德，招撫甚眾。

translations.literal: The Shizu emperor summoned Yi Erde and ordered him to follow Prince Dodo on the southern campaign, and with Minister of the Imperial Clan Handai and others to lead Mongol troops from Nanyang down to Guide, winning over a great many to submission.
translations.idiomatic: The Shizu emperor summoned Yi Erde to join Prince Dodo's southern campaign. With Minister Handai of the imperial clan he led Mongol troops from Nanyang to Guide and won over a great many people.

sentences.zh: 至揚州，獲戰監百餘，渡江先驅，破南京。

translations.literal: Reaching Yangzhou, he obtained more than a hundred war junks, crossed the river as vanguard, and broke Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: At Yangzhou he seized more than a hundred war junks, crossed the river as vanguard, and took Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 明福王由崧走蕪湖，與固山額真阿哈尼堪等追擊，敗明將黃得功。

translations.literal: The Ming Prince of Fu Zhu Yousong fled to Wuhu. With Gushan Ejen Ahanikan and others he pursued and defeated the Ming general Huang Degong.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Prince of Fu Zhu Yousong fled to Wuhu. Yi Erde joined Gushan Ejen Ahanikan in pursuit and defeated Huang Degong.

sentences.zh: 三年，進世職一等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: In the third year he was promoted to first-rank hereditary Angbang Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was promoted to first-rank hereditary Angbang Commander.

sentences.zh: 六年，偕大將軍譚泰討叛將金聲桓，下南昌，誅聲桓。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he joined Grand General Tan Tai in suppressing the rebel Jin Shengwan, took Nanchang, and executed Shengwan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined Grand General Tan Tai against the rebel Jin Shengwan, took Nanchang, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 師進，叛將李成棟陷信豐，攻克之，成棟夜遁，馬蹶，溺水死。

translations.literal: The army advanced; the rebel Li Chengdong held Xinfeng. They stormed and took it; Chengdong fled by night, his horse stumbled, and he drowned.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced on the rebel Li Chengdong at Xinfeng, took the city, and Chengdong fled by night; his horse stumbled and he drowned.

sentences.zh: 分兵定撫州、建昌，破其將楊奇盛。

translations.literal: They divided forces to settle Fuzhou and Jianchang and defeated the rebel general Yang Qisheng.
translations.idiomatic: Detachments pacified Fuzhou and Jianchang and defeated Yang Qisheng.

sentences.zh: 江西悉平。

translations.literal: Jiangxi was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi was fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 師還，复移剿保定土寇。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was again shifted to suppress bandits in Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was sent to suppress bandits in Baoding.

sentences.zh: 論功，進世職一等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: On review of merit he was promoted to first-rank hereditary Jingqi Niha.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was promoted to first-rank hereditary Jingqi Niha.

sentences.zh: 八年，巴牙喇纛章京鼇拜訐伊爾德值上幸內苑擅令門直員役更番，私減守門護軍額數，又嫉忌鰲拜等，鞫實，論死，上貸之，命降世職一級，罰鍰以贖。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Baturu Banner Commander Oboi denounced Yi Erde for, while the emperor was visiting the inner gardens, arbitrarily ordering gate attendants to change shifts and privately reducing the quota of gate-guard soldiers, and also for jealousy of Oboi and others. On investigation the charges were proved and he was sentenced to death, but the emperor spared him, ordered his hereditary rank reduced one grade, and a fine in redemption.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Oboi accused Yi Erde of changing gate shifts without authority while the emperor was in the inner gardens, cutting the gate-guard roster, and envying Oboi and others. The charges were proved and he was sentenced to death, but the emperor commuted this to a one-grade reduction in hereditary rank and a fine.

sentences.zh: 尋授本旗固山額真。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed Gushan Ejen of his own banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made Gushan Ejen of his banner.

sentences.zh: 九年，三遇恩詔，累進一等伯兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, on three amnesty edicts, he was cumulatively promoted to first-rank baron with Tushala Ha.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, through three amnesty edicts, he rose cumulatively to first-rank baron with Tushala Ha.

sentences.zh: 從敬謹親王尼堪徵湖南，師敗績，王沒於陣。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Jingjin Nikan in campaigning in Hunan. The army suffered defeat and the prince died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Prince Jingjin Nikan on the Hunan campaign. The army was defeated and the prince was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 十一年，師還，論罪，奪職籍沒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, when the army returned, on deliberation of guilt his office and property were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on the army's return, he was judged guilty and stripped of office and property.

sentences.zh: 初，明魯王以海與其將阮進等據舟山，以海走入海。

translations.literal: Earlier the Ming Prince of Lu Zhu Yihai and his generals Ruan Jin and others held Zhoushan; Yihai fled to sea.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Ming Prince of Lu Zhu Yihai and his generals Ruan Jin and others held Zhoushan until Yihai fled to sea.

sentences.zh: 至是，其將陳六禦、阮思等復據舟山為寇。

translations.literal: By this time his generals Chen Liuyu, Ruan Si, and others again held Zhoushan as pirates.
translations.idiomatic: By then his former officers Chen Liuyu, Ruan Si, and others had reoccupied Zhoushan as raiders.

sentences.zh: 十二年，上授伊爾德寧海大將軍，率師討之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the emperor appointed Yi Erde Pacification General of the Eastern Sea and ordered him to lead troops against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the emperor made Yi Erde Pacification General of the Eastern Sea and sent him to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 六禦等遣所置總兵王長樹、毛光祚、沈爾序等登陸掠大嵐山。

translations.literal: Liuyu and the others sent their appointed commanders Wang Changshu, Mao Guangzuo, Shen Erxu, and others ashore to raid Dalanshan.
translations.idiomatic: Liuyu sent his commanders Wang Changshu, Mao Guangzuo, Shen Erxu, and others ashore to raid Dalanshan.

sentences.zh: 伊爾德遣巴牙喇纛額真車爾布、梅勒額真碩祿古、總兵張承恩引兵趨夏關，抵斗門，連擊敗之，斬長樹等；

translations.literal: Yi Erde sent Baturu Banner Ejen Cheerbu, Meire Ejen Shuolugu, and Commander Zhang Chengen to lead troops toward Xiaguan, reach Doumen, defeat them in successive battles, and behead Changshu and others;
translations.idiomatic: Yi Erde sent Baturu Banner Ejen Cheerbu, Meire Ejen Shuolugu, and Commander Zhang Chengen to Xiaguan and Doumen, where they defeated the enemy in succession and killed Changshu and others;

sentences.zh: 而自率師攻寧波，乘舟趨定海，分三道並進。

translations.literal: he himself led troops to attack Ningbo, took boats toward Dinghai, and advanced by three routes together.
translations.idiomatic: while he himself attacked Ningbo by sea toward Dinghai in three columns.

sentences.zh: 六禦等列舟望江口山下以待，伊爾德揮眾進擊，敗之；

translations.literal: Liuyu and the others lined their boats below Wangjiangkou to await him; Yi Erde led the host forward in attack and defeated them;
translations.idiomatic: Liuyu drew up his fleet below Wangjiangkou to meet him; Yi Erde attacked and routed them;

sentences.zh: 追至衡水洋，斬六禦等，遂取舟山。

translations.literal: pursued to Hengshuiyang, beheaded Liuyu and the others, and then took Zhoushan.
translations.idiomatic: pursued them to Hengshuiyang, killed Liuyu and his officers, and took Zhoushan.

sentences.zh: 十四年，師還，上命貝勒杜蘭等郊勞，复世職，論功，進一等伯。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, when the army returned, the emperor ordered Prince Dulan and others to welcome it in the suburbs; his hereditary rank was restored, and on review of merit he was promoted to first-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, on the army's return, Prince Dulan and others were sent to welcome it outside the city; his hereditary rank was restored and he was promoted to first-rank baron for his service.

sentences.zh: 十五年，從信郡王多尼南征，自貴陽至盤江，擊斬明將，進克雲南。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he followed Prince Xin Duoni on the southern campaign from Guiyang to the Pan River, attacked and beheaded Ming generals, and advanced to take Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he joined Prince Xin Duoni on the southern campaign from Guiyang to the Pan River, killed Ming generals in battle, and advanced to conquer Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 十八年，卒於軍，諡襄敏。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he died in camp and was granted the posthumous title Xiangmin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he died in camp and received the posthumous title Xiangmin.

sentences.zh: 孫巴琿岱，襲。

translations.literal: His grandson Ba Fendai inherited the rank.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Ba Fendai inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 自散秩大臣遷正黃旗滿洲都統。

translations.literal: From minister without portfolio he was transferred to be Manchu commander of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from minister without portfolio to Manchu commander of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 夏逢龍之亂，出為荊州將軍。

translations.literal: During the rebellion of Xia Fenglong he was sent out as Jingzhou General.
translations.idiomatic: When Xia Fenglong rebelled, he was dispatched as Jingzhou General.

sentences.zh: 聖祖徵噶爾丹，參贊大將軍馬斯喀軍務。

translations.literal: When the Shengzu emperor campaigned against Galdan, he assisted Grand General Maski in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shengzu emperor marched against Galdan, he served as deputy to Grand General Maski.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡恪恭。

translations.literal: He died and was granted the posthumous title Ke Gong.
translations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous title Ke Gong.

sentences.zh: 子馬哈達，降二等伯，世襲。

translations.literal: His son Mahada inherited at reduced rank as second-class baron, in perpetual succession.
translations.idiomatic: His son Mahada inherited at reduced rank as a second-class baron.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，加封號宣義。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong period a supplemental title Xuanyi was added.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign the supplemental title Xuanyi was conferred.

sentences.zh: =努山=努山，扎庫塔氏，世居鄂裡。

translations.literal: Nushan — Nushan was of the Jakuta clan and had dwelt at Oli for generations.
translations.idiomatic: Nushan was of the Jakuta clan, his family having lived at Oli for generations.

sentences.zh: 父塔克都，歸太祖，太祖命籍其眾為牛錄，以其長子瑚什屯為牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His father Taketu submitted to the Taizu emperor. The Taizu emperor ordered his followers registered as a niru and appointed his eldest son Hushitun niru commander.
translations.idiomatic: His father Taketu came over to the Taizu emperor, who registered their followers as a niru and made the eldest son Hushitun niru commander.

sentences.zh: 旗制定，隸滿洲正黃旗。

translations.literal: When the banners were fixed, they were assigned to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Once the banner system was established, they were placed in the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 積功，授世職游擊。

translations.literal: Through accumulated merit he was granted the hereditary rank of Guerrilla Colonel.
translations.idiomatic: For accumulated service he received the hereditary rank of Guerrilla Colonel.

sentences.zh: 卒，無子，以努山子渾岱為後，襲職，而努山代為牛錄額真。

translations.literal: When he died without a son, Nushan's son Hundai was made his heir and inherited the post, while Nushan took his place as niru commander.
translations.idiomatic: He died childless; Nushan's son Hundai was adopted as heir and inherited the rank, and Nushan himself became niru commander.

sentences.zh: 從征伐，輒先驅覘敵。

translations.literal: On campaigns he always went ahead as vanguard to reconnoiter the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On campaign he invariably rode ahead as vanguard to scout the enemy.

sentences.zh: 有功，授噶布什賢章京。

translations.literal: For merit he was appointed Gabsihiyan Commander.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was made Gabsihiyan Commander.

sentences.zh: 太宗嘉其能，以瑚什屯世職改命努山，諭曰：「弟之子不若弟親也。

translations.literal: The Taizong commended his ability, transferred Hushitun's hereditary post to Nushan, and instructed him, saying, "A younger brother's son is not as close as a younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizong praised his talent, reassigned Hushitun's hereditary post to Nushan, and told him, "A younger brother's son is not as close as a younger brother.

sentences.zh: 」時為天聰八年五月。

translations.literal: " It was then the fifth month of the eighth year of Tiancong.
translations.idiomatic: This was in the fifth month of Tiancong 8.

sentences.zh: 尋從伐明，攻大同，努山與甲喇額真席特庫、納海執邏卒以獻。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he followed in the campaign against Ming and attacked Datong. Nushan, together with Jalan Ejen Xiteku and Nihai, captured patrol soldiers and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: He soon joined the Ming campaign and the attack on Datong. Nushan, with Jalan Ejen Xiteku and Nihai, seized Ming patrolmen and brought them in.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，率甲士行邊，至冷口，遇明邏卒十四，斬三人，俘一人，獲馬十餘。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he led armored soldiers on a frontier patrol to Lengkou, met fourteen Ming patrol soldiers, beheaded three, captured one, and seized more than ten horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he led armored troops along the frontier to Lengkou, encountered fourteen Ming patrolmen, killed three, took one prisoner, and captured more than ten horses.

sentences.zh: 三年，從貝勒岳託伐明，將入邊，遇明兵，斬四十人，俘三人。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Yueto in attacking Ming. About to enter the frontier, they met Ming troops, beheaded forty men, and captured three.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined Prince Yueto's Ming campaign. As they were about to cross the border they met Ming forces, killed forty men, and took three prisoners.

sentences.zh: 發明兵所置火藥。

translations.literal: They seized the gunpowder the Ming troops had stored.
translations.idiomatic: They captured the gunpowder the Ming army had stockpiled.

sentences.zh: 度牆子嶺，明總兵吳阿衡將六千人迎戰，擊之敗。

translations.literal: Crossing the Qiangzi Pass, they met Ming Regional Commander Wu Aheng leading six thousand men to give battle and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing Qiangzi Pass, they met Regional Commander Wu Aheng with six thousand men coming out to fight and routed him.

sentences.zh: 與噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦勞薩逐明兵，獲馬數十及攻具。

translations.literal: Together with Gabsihiyan Angbang Commander Laosa he pursued the Ming troops and seized several dozen horses and siege equipment.
translations.idiomatic: With Gabsihiyan Angbang Commander Laosa he chased the Ming army and captured dozens of horses and siege gear.

sentences.zh: 薄明都，破明兵為伏者，而自設伏道側，挑明太監高起潛戰，伏起夾擊，多所俘馘​​。

translations.literal: Pressing close to the Ming capital, they broke up Ming troops lying in ambush, then themselves set an ambush beside the road, drew the Ming eunuch Gao Qiqian into battle, and when the ambush rose to attack from both sides took many prisoners and heads.
translations.idiomatic: Near the Ming capital they routed an ambushing Ming force, then laid their own ambush by the road, baited the Ming eunuch Gao Qiqian into battle, and when their men sprang up on both sides killed and captured a great many.

sentences.zh: 即夕，起潛襲噶布什賢兵，努山與席特庫及甲喇額真鄂克合兵戰，起潛兵敗走，逐北，迫會通河，明兵多入水死，遂次涿州；

translations.literal: That same evening Qiqian raided the Gabsihiyan troops. Nushan joined Xiteku and Jalan Ejen Eke in battle; Qiqian's army was defeated and fled. Pursuing the routed enemy to the Huitong River, many Ming soldiers drowned in the water, and they then halted at Zhuozhou;
translations.idiomatic: That night Qiqian attacked the Gabsihiyan force. Nushan, Xiteku, and Jalan Ejen Eke combined to fight him; Qiqian's troops broke and fled. In the pursuit to the Huitong River many Ming soldiers drowned, and the army then encamped at Zhuozhou;

sentences.zh: 分道從睿親王多爾袞徇山東，克濟南。

translations.literal: by separate routes they followed Prince Regent Dorgon in sweeping Shandong and captured Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: then by separate columns they followed Prince Regent Dorgon through Shandong and took Jinan.

sentences.zh: 師還，出塞，復與勞薩共敗明兵。

translations.literal: When the army returned and went out beyond the pass, he again joined Laosa in defeating Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march beyond the frontier he again joined Laosa in defeating Ming forces.

sentences.zh: 六年七月，與侍衛穆章等诇敵董家口、喜峰口，遇明兵，斬百餘人，俘四人。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year, together with Bodyguard Muzhang and others he reconnoitered the enemy at Dongjiakou and Xifengkou, met Ming troops, beheaded more than a hundred men, and captured four.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year he scouted the enemy at Dongjiakou and Xifengkou with Bodyguard Muzhang and others, killed more than a hundred Ming soldiers, and took four prisoners.

sentences.zh: 從圍錦州，是時上自將駐軍松山、杏山道中，明兵擊噶布什賢兵，努山力戰，斬五十二人，獲馬三十。

translations.literal: He followed in besieging Jinzhou. At that time the emperor personally commanded the army encamped on the road between Songshan and Xingshan. Ming troops attacked the Gabsihiyan force; Nushan fought fiercely, beheaded fifty-two men, and seized thirty horses.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the siege of Jinzhou. The emperor was then in personal command, encamped on the road between Songshan and Xingshan. When Ming troops struck the Gabsihiyan force, Nushan fought hard, killed fifty-two men, and captured thirty horses.

sentences.zh: 明總督洪承疇出戰，努山與勞薩等陣而前，戰良久，王貝勒等各以所部合戰，大破明兵。
