translations.literal: Ming Governor-General Hong Chengchou came out to give battle. Nushan and Laosa and others advanced in battle formation and fought for a long time; the princes and beile each joined with their own commands, and the Ming army was thoroughly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Governor-General Hong Chengchou came out to fight. Nushan, Laosa, and the others advanced in formation and battled for a long time until the princes and beile brought up their commands; together they shattered the Ming army.

sentences.zh: 十月，擢噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he was promoted to Gabsihiyan Angbang Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was promoted to Gabsihiyan Angbang Commander.

sentences.zh: 是時武英郡王阿濟格駐軍杏山河岸，上命努山濟師。

translations.literal: At that time Prince Ying Ajige was encamped on the bank of the Xingshan River. The emperor ordered Nushan to reinforce the army.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ying Ajige was then encamped on the Xingshan River. The emperor ordered Nushan to bring up reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 敵騎千自寧遠至，猝與努山值，驚潰，努山逐之，至連山，斬三十人，獲馬三十有二。

translations.literal: A thousand enemy horsemen came from Ningyuan, suddenly met Nushan, panicked and broke, and Nushan pursued them to Lianshan, beheaded thirty men, and seized thirty-two horses.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand enemy cavalry came from Ningyuan, ran into Nushan by surprise, broke in panic, and were chased to Lianshan, where he killed thirty men and captured thirty-two horses.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，與噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦吳拜共略寧遠，敵騎五十自中後所至，率噶布什賢兵縱擊，明兵四百人來援，並擊敗之；

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year, together with Gabsihiyan Angbang Commander Wu Bai he raided Ningyuan. Fifty enemy horsemen came from Zhonghousuo; he led the Gabsihiyan troops in a sweeping charge, and when four hundred Ming soldiers came to their relief he defeated them all;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year he joined Gabsihiyan Angbang Commander Wu Bai in raiding Ningyuan. Fifty enemy horsemen came from Zhonghousuo; he led the Gabsihiyan force in a charge and, when four hundred Ming troops came to relieve them, defeated both groups;

sentences.zh: 薄寧遠，守者背城陣，努山等與戰，俘二十三人：進世職二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: Pressing close to Ningyuan, the defenders formed a line with their backs to the wall. Nushan and the others fought them and captured twenty-three men: he was promoted to second-class hereditary Jalan Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Near Ningyuan the defenders drew up with their backs to the wall. Nushan and his men fought them and took twenty-three prisoners, and he was promoted to second-class hereditary Jalan Commander.

sentences.zh: 八年，上以貝勒阿巴泰等略山東未還，命努山率甲喇額真四、侍衛四、兵九十至界嶺口，诇師行距邊遠近，遇明兵，斬守備一、兵三百餘，俘數十人，獲馬騾二百餘。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because Prince Abatai and others who were raiding Shandong had not yet returned, the emperor ordered Nushan to lead four Jalan Ejen, four bodyguards, and ninety soldiers to Jielingkou to reconnoiter how far the army's march was from the frontier. They met Ming troops, beheaded one garrison commander and more than three hundred soldiers, captured several dozen men, and seized more than two hundred horses and mules.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, while Prince Abatai's Shandong raid had not yet returned, the emperor sent Nushan with four Jalan Ejen, four bodyguards, and ninety soldiers to Jielingkou to scout how close the army was to the border. They met Ming forces, killed a garrison commander and more than three hundred soldiers, took several dozen prisoners, and captured more than two hundred horses and mules.

sentences.zh: 八月，與巴牙喇纛章京阿濟格尼堪帥師戍錦州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he joined Baturu Banner Commander Aji Ge Nikan in leading troops to garrison Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he joined Baturu Banner Commander Aji Ge Nikan in garrisoning Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，世祖既定鼎，命努山將左翼噶布什賢兵從豫親王多鐸西討李自成，自成兵出潼關拒戰，努山自間道劘其壘，斬殺過半，自成兵潰走。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, after the Shizu emperor had fixed the capital, he ordered Nushan to lead the Left Wing Gabsihiyan troops to follow Prince Dodo in the western campaign against Li Zicheng. Zicheng's troops came out through Tongguan to resist. Nushan by a bypath struck their camp, killed and wounded more than half, and Zicheng's army broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1, once the Shizu emperor had established the capital, he ordered Nushan to lead the Left Wing Gabsihiyan force under Prince Dodo against Li Zicheng in the west. Zicheng's army came out at Tongguan to resist. Nushan took a side road, stormed their camp, killed more than half, and Zicheng's troops broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 二年，移師定河南​​，下揚州，克明南京。

translations.literal: In the second year the army moved to pacify Henan, took Yangzhou, and captured the Ming Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the army moved to secure Henan, took Yangzhou, and captured the Ming Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 明福王由崧走蕪湖，努山與諸將以師從之，得福王以歸。

translations.literal: The Ming Prince of Fu Zhu Yousong fled to Wuhu. Nushan and the generals followed with the army and brought the Prince of Fu back.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Prince of Fu Zhu Yousong fled to Wuhu. Nushan and the other generals pursued with the army and captured him.

sentences.zh: 三年，從貝勒博洛徇浙江，明總兵方國安屯錢塘江東岸，以舟師出戰。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Bolo in sweeping Zhejiang. Ming Regional Commander Fang Guoan was encamped on the east bank of the Qiantang River and came out with a fleet to give battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined Prince Bolo's sweep through Zhejiang. Ming Regional Commander Fang Guoan was posted on the east bank of the Qiantang River and met them with a fleet.

sentences.zh: 努山從固山額真圖賴自上游渡，擊國安，敗之，盡得其舟；

translations.literal: Nushan followed Gushan Ejen Tu Lai in crossing from upstream, attacked Guoan, defeated him, and seized all his boats;
translations.idiomatic: Nushan crossed upstream with Gushan Ejen Tu Lai, attacked Guoan, routed him, and captured his entire fleet;

sentences.zh: 進略福建，擊斬明巡撫楊廷清、李暄。

translations.literal: advancing to raid Fujian, he attacked and beheaded the Ming grand coordinators Yang Tingqing and Li Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: then advanced into Fujian, where he killed the Ming grand coordinators Yang Tingqing and Li Xuan in battle.

sentences.zh: 時巴牙喇纛章京都爾德等攻下建寧、延平諸府，明唐王聿鍵走汀州，努山馳七晝夜追及之，唐王入城守，令銳卒以巨木撞其門，後軍繼至，遂克之。

translations.literal: At that time Baturu Banner Commander Durde and others captured the prefectures of Jianning, Yanping, and the rest. The Ming Prince of Tang Zhu Yujian fled to Tingzhou. Nushan rode hard for seven days and nights and overtook him. The Prince of Tang entered the city to hold it. Nushan ordered picked soldiers to batter the gate with great logs; the rear army arrived in support, and the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Baturu Banner Commander Durde and others had meanwhile taken Jianning, Yanping, and the other prefectures. The Ming Prince of Tang Zhu Yujian fled to Tingzhou. Nushan rode seven days and nights without rest and caught up with him. The Prince of Tang shut himself in the city; Nushan sent elite troops to ram the gate with great beams, the rear army came up, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 五年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗定湖廣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Prince Jirhalang in pacifying Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined Prince Jirhalang in pacifying Huguang.

sentences.zh: 明桂王由榔據廣西，其總督何騰蛟，總兵王進才、馬進忠、袁宗第等，分屯湖南諸郡邑。

translations.literal: The Ming Prince of Gui Zhu Youlang held Guangxi. His governor-general He Tengjiao and regional commanders Wang Jincai, Ma Jinzhong, Yuan Zongdi, and others were posted separately in the prefectures and districts of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Prince of Gui Zhu Youlang held Guangxi, while Governor-General He Tengjiao and regional commanders Wang Jincai, Ma Jinzhong, Yuan Zongdi, and others were scattered through Hunan's prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，努山至長沙，時席特庫亦遷噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦，將右翼噶布什賢兵，共簡精銳攻湘潭，與固山額真阿濟格尼堪等破北門入，騰蛟死之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year Nushan reached Changsha. At that time Xiteku had also been transferred to Gabsihiyan Angbang Commander and commanded the Right Wing Gabsihiyan troops. Together they selected picked troops to attack Xiangtan. With Gushan Ejen Aji Ge Nikan and others they broke in through the north gate, and Tengjiao was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year Nushan reached Changsha. Xiteku had by then been made Gabsihiyan Angbang Commander of the Right Wing Gabsihiyan force. Together they chose elite troops to assault Xiangtan. With Gushan Ejen Aji Ge Nikan and others they broke through the north gate, and Tengjiao was killed.

sentences.zh: 四月，兵部尚書阿哈尼堪等徇寶慶，未至七十里，進才、進忠合軍出禦，努山令所部舍騎步戰，明兵敗，薄城東門，進才等棄城走，逐之至武岡，殲進忠所將步兵三千，破進才及宗第等寨十餘，分克沅州、靖州；

translations.literal: In the fourth month Minister of War Ahanikan and others swept toward Baoqing. When they were still seventy li away, Jincai and Jinzhong combined their armies to oppose them. Nushan ordered his command to dismount and fight on foot. The Ming army was defeated. Pressing close to the east gate of the city, Jincai and the others abandoned the city and fled. Pursuing them to Wugang, they annihilated the three thousand foot soldiers under Jinzhong's command, broke more than ten stockades of Jincai, Zongdi, and the others, and separately captured Yuanzhou and Jingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Minister of War Ahanikan and others advanced on Baoqing. Seventy li short of the city, Jincai and Jinzhong united to meet them. Nushan ordered his men to dismount and fight on foot, routed the Ming army, and pressed the east gate until Jincai and the others abandoned the city and fled. The pursuit reached Wugang, where three thousand of Jinzhong's infantry were wiped out, more than ten stockades of Jincai and Zongdi were broken, and Yuanzhou and Jingzhou were taken in separate columns;

sentences.zh: 再進克全州，斬明閣部楊鰲及副將以下四十餘。

translations.literal: Advancing again they captured Quanzhou and beheaded the Ming grand secretary Yang Ao and more than forty officers below vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing on, they took Quanzhou and killed Grand Secretary Yang Ao of the Ming and more than forty officers down to vice commander.

sentences.zh: 累進二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: He was successively promoted to second-class Ashan-i Niha.
translations.idiomatic: He was eventually promoted to second-class Ashan-i Niha.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢內大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to Inner Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was made Inner Minister.

sentences.zh: 十五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fifteenth year.

sentences.zh: =阿濟格尼堪=阿濟格尼堪，滿洲正白旗人，達音布子。

translations.literal: Aji Ge Nikan — Aji Ge Nikan was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and a son of Dayinbu.
translations.idiomatic: Aji Ge Nikan was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and the son of Dayinbu.

sentences.zh: 達音布戰死，長子阿哈尼堪襲三等甲喇章京，旋卒。

translations.literal: Dayinbu died in battle. His eldest son Ahanikan inherited as third-class Jalan Commander and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: Dayinbu was killed in battle. His eldest son Ahanikan inherited as third-class Jalan Commander but soon died.

sentences.zh: 阿濟格尼堪繼襲，授甲喇額真。

translations.literal: Aji Ge Nikan inherited in succession and was appointed Jalan Ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Aji Ge Nikan inherited next and was appointed Jalan Ejen.

sentences.zh: 從太宗伐察哈爾，自大同入明境，與雅賴共擊敗明兵於崞縣。

translations.literal: He followed the Taizong in attacking the Chahar, entered Ming territory from Datong, and together with Yalai jointly defeated Ming troops at Guo County.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the Taizong against the Chahar, entered Ming territory from Datong, and with Yalai defeated Ming forces at Guo County.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從太宗伐朝鮮，擊敗明寧遠守邊兵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed the Taizong in attacking Korea and defeated the Ming border garrison at Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he joined the Taizong's Korean campaign and defeated the Ming border force at Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 三年，從貝勒岳託伐明，擊破總兵侯世祿，得其印及騎。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Yueto in attacking Ming, routed Regional Commander Hou Shilu, and seized his seal and horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined Prince Yueto's Ming campaign, defeated Regional Commander Hou Shilu, and captured his seal and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 四年，擢巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to Baturu Banner Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made Baturu Banner Commander.

sentences.zh: 從肅親王豪格攻錦州，設伏於連山，俘五人，獲馬七。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Su Ajige in attacking Jinzhou, set an ambush at Lianshan, captured five men, and seized seven horses.
translations.idiomatic: He served under Prince Su Ajige at the Jinzhou siege, laid an ambush at Lianshan, took five prisoners, and captured seven horses.

sentences.zh: 六年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗攻錦州，以七十人為伏，敗敵；

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Prince Jirhalang in attacking Jinzhou, used seventy men as an ambush, and defeated the enemy;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined Prince Jirhalang's Jinzhou campaign, set seventy men in ambush, and routed the enemy;

sentences.zh: 進攻杏山，領纛直入敵壘，敵大潰。

translations.literal: advancing to attack Xingshan, he led the banner straight into the enemy camp and the foe broke in great disorder.
translations.idiomatic: then attacked Xingshan, carrying the banner straight into the enemy lines until the foe collapsed in rout.

sentences.zh: 時錦州有蒙古諾木齊等原降，明總兵祖大壽發其謀，以兵圍之，不得出。

translations.literal: At that time in Jinzhou the Mongols Nomuchi and others, who had originally surrendered, had their plot exposed by Ming Regional Commander Zu Dashou, who surrounded them with troops so they could not get out.
translations.idiomatic: At Jinzhou the Mongols Nomuchi and others, who had earlier defected, were betrayed by Ming Regional Commander Zu Dashou, who surrounded them and trapped them inside.

sentences.zh: 阿濟格尼堪诇知之，乘夜薄城，力戰先登，入其郛，援諾木齊等皆出。

translations.literal: Aji Ge Nikan learned this through reconnaissance, pressed close to the city by night, fought fiercely and was first to ascend, entered the outer enclosure, and rescued Nomuchi and the others, who all came out.
translations.idiomatic: Aji Ge Nikan learned of this through scouts, approached the city by night, fought his way in first over the wall, entered the outer town, and brought Nomuchi and the others out.

sentences.zh: 進攻松山，戰屢捷。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Songshan, he won repeated victories in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the advance on Songshan he won victory after victory.

sentences.zh: 上以阿濟格尼堪少年能殺敵，進一等參將，賚白金四百。

translations.literal: Because Aji Ge Nikan was young yet able to kill the enemy, the emperor promoted him to first-class Colonel and bestowed four hundred taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, noting that though young Aji Ge Nikan could kill the enemy in battle, promoted him to first-class Colonel and granted him four hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 是年八月，明總督洪承疇集諸鎮兵救錦州，上自將屯松山、杏山道中，絕餉道。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of that year Ming Governor-General Hong Chengchou gathered the troops of the garrisons to relieve Jinzhou. The emperor personally commanded the army encamped on the road between Songshan and Xingshan and cut off the supply route.
translations.idiomatic: That August, Ming Governor-General Hong Chengchou assembled garrison troops to relieve Jinzhou. The emperor took command in person, encamped on the road between Songshan and Xingshan, and severed the supply line.

sentences.zh: 明總兵吳三桂、唐通等皆潛引去。

translations.literal: The Ming regional commanders Wu Sangui, Tang Tong, and others all secretly withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Ming regional commanders Wu Sangui, Tang Tong, and others all slipped away in secret.

sentences.zh: 上召阿濟格尼堪親授策，與鰲拜等追擊，大敗之。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned Aji Ge Nikan and personally gave him his plan. With Oboi and others he pursued and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned Aji Ge Nikan, gave him his orders in person, and with Oboi and others he pursued and routed the enemy.

sentences.zh: 八年八月，命戍錦州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighth year he was ordered to garrison Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the eighth year he was assigned to garrison Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，鄭親王取中後所、前屯衛，阿濟格尼堪率所部及蒙古兵攻中前所，拔其城，俘明潰兵，無得脫者，加半個前程。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Prince Jirhalang took Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei. Aji Ge Nikan led his command and Mongol troops to attack Zhongqiansuo, captured the city, and took the routed Ming soldiers — none escaped — and was granted half a rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Prince Jirhalang took Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei. Aji Ge Nikan led his own troops and Mongol forces against Zhongqiansuo, captured the city, and rounded up the fleeing Ming soldiers without a single escape; he received half a step of promotion credit.

sentences.zh: 順治元年四月，從睿親王多爾袞入關，破李自成，追至慶都，進一等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Shunzhi he followed Prince Regent Dorgon in entering the pass, defeated Li Zicheng, pursued him to Qingdu, and was promoted to first-class Meire Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Shunzhi 1 he followed Prince Regent Dorgon through the pass, defeated Li Zicheng, pursued him to Qingdu, and was promoted to first-class Meire Commander.

sentences.zh: 十月，從豫親王多鐸帥師西討自成，渡孟津，薄潼關。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he followed Prince Dodo, who commanded the army in the western campaign against Zicheng, crossed the Mengjin ford, and pressed close to Tongguan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he joined Prince Dodo's western campaign against Zicheng, crossed at Mengjin, and approached Tongguan.

sentences.zh: 賊鑿重壕為固，自成將劉方亮率千餘人出拒，阿濟格尼堪與圖賴、阿爾津等奮戰，方亮敗退。

translations.literal: The rebels dug deep trenches for defense. Zicheng's general Liu Fangliang led more than a thousand men out to resist. Aji Ge Nikan, together with Tu Lai, Arjin, and others, fought fiercely and Fangliang was defeated and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels had dug deep trenches for defense. Zicheng's general Liu Fangliang came out with more than a thousand men to resist. Aji Ge Nikan, Tu Lai, Arjin, and the others fought hard and drove Fangliang back.

sentences.zh: 至夜，復來犯，阿濟格尼堪力戰卻之，連破賊二壘，遂麾兵逾壕，冒矢石先登，賊驚潰降竄，師入關。

translations.literal: By night they came again to attack. Aji Ge Nikan fought fiercely and repulsed them, successively broke two rebel camps, then led his troops over the trench, braved arrows and stones to ascend first, and the rebels panicked, broke, surrendered, and scattered; the army entered the pass.
translations.idiomatic: At night they attacked again. Aji Ge Nikan fought them off, took two rebel camps in succession, then led his men over the trench and up under fire ahead of all others. The rebels broke in panic, surrendered, and fled, and the army entered the pass.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，克西安，自成自商州入湖廣。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year they captured Xi'an. Zicheng entered Huguang from Shangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year Xi'an fell, and Zicheng withdrew from Shangzhou into Huguang.

sentences.zh: 豫親王移師下江南，四月，至淮安，遣阿濟格尼堪率所部趨揚州，屯城北，與親軍合攻，城遂下，獲戰艦二百餘；

translations.literal: Prince Dodo moved the army south into Jiangnan. In the fourth month, reaching Huai'an, he dispatched Aji Ge Nikan to lead his command toward Yangzhou, encamp north of the city, and join the imperial guard in a combined assault; the city was taken and more than two hundred warships were seized;
translations.idiomatic: Prince Dodo shifted south into Jiangnan. In the fourth month, reaching Huai'an, he sent Aji Ge Nikan with his command toward Yangzhou, where he encamped north of the city and joined the imperial guard in the assault; the city fell and more than two hundred warships were captured;

sentences.zh: 渡江克明南都，追擊明福王由崧於蕪湖，敗其舟師：進三等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: crossing the river they captured the Ming Southern Capital, pursued the Ming Prince of Fu Zhu Yousong at Wuhu, and defeated his fleet: he was promoted to third-class Angbang Commander.
translations.idiomatic: crossing the Yangtze they took the Ming Southern Capital, pursued the Ming Prince of Fu Zhu Yousong at Wuhu, and destroyed his fleet; he was promoted to third-class Angbang Commander.

sentences.zh: 三年，從端重親王博洛定浙江，徇金華、衢州，破仙霞關，略建寧、延平。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo in pacifying Zhejiang, swept Jinhua and Quzhou, broke through Xianxia Pass, and raided Jianning and Yanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined Prince Duanzhong Bolo in pacifying Zhejiang, swept through Jinhua and Quzhou, forced Xianxia Pass, and overran Jianning and Yanping.

sentences.zh: 明唐王聿鍵走汀州，阿濟格尼堪與都爾德進擊至城下，率精銳先登，遂克汀州。

translations.literal: The Ming Prince of Tang Zhu Yujian fled to Tingzhou. Aji Ge Nikan and Durde advanced in pursuit to the foot of the city wall. He led picked troops to ascend first, and Tingzhou was taken.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Prince of Tang Zhu Yujian fled to Tingzhou. Aji Ge Nikan and Durde pursued to the walls; he led elite troops over first, and Tingzhou fell.

sentences.zh: 其總兵姜正希以二萬人赴援，阿濟格尼堪出禦，所殺傷過半。

translations.literal: His regional commander Jiang Zhengxi came with twenty thousand men to relieve the city. Aji Ge Nikan went out to meet them and killed and wounded more than half.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Jiang Zhengxi came with twenty thousand men to relieve the city. Aji Ge Nikan went out to meet him and killed or wounded more than half his force.

sentences.zh: 進一等精奇尼哈番，賜敕世襲。

translations.literal: He was promoted to first-class Jingqi Niha and granted an edict of perpetual inheritance.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to first-class Jingqi Niha and granted an edict confirming hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 五年，授正白旗滿洲都統。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed Manchu commander of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made Manchu commander of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 六年，鄭親王濟爾哈朗徵湖廣，以阿濟格尼堪參贊軍事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Prince Jirhalang campaigned in Huguang and appointed Aji Ge Nikan to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Prince Jirhalang marched on Huguang and made Aji Ge Nikan his deputy in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 是時明總督何騰蛟，總兵王進才、馬進忠等，守湖南：騰蛟軍湘潭；

translations.literal: At that time the Ming governor-general He Tengjiao and regional commanders Wang Jincai, Ma Jinzhong, and others held Hunan: Tengjiao's army was at Xiangtan;
translations.idiomatic: The Ming governor-general He Tengjiao and regional commanders Wang Jincai, Ma Jinzhong, and others then held Hunan: Tengjiao at Xiangtan;

sentences.zh: 進才、進忠軍寶慶。

translations.literal: Jincai and Jinzhong's armies were at Baoqing.
translations.idiomatic: Jincai and Jinzhong at Baoqing.

sentences.zh: 阿濟格尼堪至長沙，與兵部尚書阿哈尼堪為前鋒，攻湘潭，破北門入，執騰蛟。

translations.literal: Aji Ge Nikan reached Changsha and, together with Minister of War Ahanikan as vanguard, attacked Xiangtan, broke in through the north gate, and seized Tengjiao.
translations.idiomatic: Aji Ge Nikan reached Changsha and, with Minister of War Ahanikan in the vanguard, assaulted Xiangtan, broke through the north gate, and captured Tengjiao.

sentences.zh: 逐明潰兵至湘鄉，盡殲之，遂趨寶慶。

translations.literal: Pursuing the routed Ming troops to Xiangxiang, he annihilated them all, then hastened toward Baoqing.
translations.idiomatic: He chased the fleeing Ming troops to Xiangxiang, wiped them out, and then pressed on toward Baoqing.

sentences.zh: 未至七十里，進才、進忠合軍拒戰，阿濟格尼堪令步騎番進，薄寶慶東郭，進才等敗遁。

translations.literal: When he was still seventy li away, Jincai and Jinzhong combined their armies to resist. Aji Ge Nikan ordered infantry and cavalry to advance in turns, pressed close to the east suburb of Baoqing, and Jincai and the others were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Seventy li short of the city, Jincai and Jinzhong united to resist. Aji Ge Nikan sent infantry and cavalry forward in alternating waves, pressed the east suburbs of Baoqing, and Jincai and the others broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 遂下沅、靖，進克全州。

translations.literal: He then took Yuan and Jing and advanced to capture Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then took Yuanzhou and Jingzhou and advanced to capture Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，師還，進三等伯，賚白金五百，授議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, when the army returned, he was promoted to third-class baron, bestowed five hundred taels of white silver, and appointed Deliberative Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year, on the army's return, he was promoted to third-class baron, granted five hundred taels of silver, and made Deliberative Minister.

sentences.zh: 四月，卒，諡勇敏。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he died and was granted the posthumous title Yongmin.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fourth month and received the posthumous title Yongmin.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，加封號襄寧。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong period a supplemental title Xiangning was added.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign the supplemental title Xiangning was conferred.

sentences.zh: 子宜理布，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Yilibu has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yilibu has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: =佟圖賴=佟圖賴，漢軍鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Tong Tu Lai — Tong Tu Lai was a Han Chinese Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Tu Lai was a Han Chinese Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 父養真。

translations.literal: His father was Yangzhen.
translations.idiomatic: His father was Yangzhen.

sentences.zh: 太祖克撫順，養真以從弟養性已降，挈其族來歸。

translations.literal: When the Taizu emperor captured Fushun, Yangzhen, because his younger cousin Yangxing had already surrendered, brought his clan to submit.
translations.idiomatic: After the Taizu emperor took Fushun, Yangzhen, whose younger cousin Yangxing had already come over, brought his clan in submission.

sentences.zh: 從攻遼陽，以功授世職游擊。

translations.literal: He followed in the attack on Liaoyang and, for merit, was granted the hereditary rank of Guerrilla Colonel.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the Liaoyang campaign and, for his service, received the hereditary rank of Guerrilla Colonel.

sentences.zh: 命駐鎮江，守將陳良策以城叛，養真及長子豐年皆死。

translations.literal: He was ordered to garrison Zhenjiang. The garrison commander Chen Liangce rebelled with the city, and Yangzhen and his eldest son Fengnian both died.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted to garrison Zhenjiang. When the garrison commander Chen Liangce rebelled with the city, Yangzhen and his eldest son Fengnian were both killed.

sentences.zh: 佟圖賴初名盛年，其次子也，襲世職，事太宗。

translations.literal: Tong Tu Lai was originally named Shengnian and was Yangzhen's second son. He inherited the hereditary post and served the Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Tu Lai, originally named Shengnian, was Yangzhen's second son. He inherited the hereditary rank and served the Taizong.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年，從攻大凌河，破明監軍道張春兵，進世職二等參將。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tiancong he followed in the attack on Dalinhe, defeated the troops of Ming Military Inspector Zhang Chun, and was promoted to second-class hereditary Colonel.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 5 he joined the Dalinhe campaign, defeated the force of Ming Military Inspector Zhang Chun, and was promoted to second-class hereditary Colonel.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，授兵部右參政。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he was appointed Right Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3 he was appointed Right Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 五年，從攻錦州，取白官兒屯台。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed in attacking Jinzhou and took the Baiguan'er beacon tower.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the Jinzhou campaign and took the Baiguan'er beacon tower.

sentences.zh: 六年，復從攻錦州，取金塔口三台。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he again followed in attacking Jinzhou and took the three towers at Jintakou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again joined the Jinzhou campaign and took the three towers at Jintakou.

sentences.zh: 七年，從攻松山，明師以騎兵突陣，將奪我師砲，佟圖賴擊卻之；

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed in attacking Songshan. The Ming army charged the line with cavalry intending to seize our cannon; Tong Tu Lai beat them back;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he joined the Songshan campaign. Ming cavalry burst into the line to seize our guns; Tong Tu Lai drove them off;

sentences.zh: 又敗其步兵，取塔山、杏山諸台，遂克其城二：以功進世職一等。

translations.literal: he again defeated their infantry, took the towers of Tashan, Xingshan, and the rest, and then captured their two cities; for merit he was promoted to first-class hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: routed their infantry, took the towers at Tashan and Xingshan, and captured both cities, earning promotion to first-class hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 是歲始分漢軍為八旗，授正藍旗固山額真。

translations.literal: That year the Chinese Army was first divided into Eight Banners, and he was appointed Gushan Ejen of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: That year, when the Chinese Army was first organized into Eight Banners, he was made Gushan Ejen of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 師出略明邊，佟圖賴與固山額真李國翰等奏請直取燕京，上以「未取關外四城，何能即克山海」，優旨開諭之。

translations.literal: When the army went out to raid the Ming frontier, Tong Tu Lai and Gushan Ejen Li Guohan and others memorialized asking to march straight on Yanjing. The emperor said, "If we have not yet taken the four cities beyond the pass, how can we immediately take Shanhai?" and issued a gracious edict to enlighten them.
translations.idiomatic: On a frontier raid Tong Tu Lai and Gushan Ejen Li Guohan and others asked permission to march directly on Beijing. The emperor replied that without the four northeastern cities they could not yet take Shanhaiguan, and sent a gracious edict explaining his reasoning.

sentences.zh: 八年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗收前屯衛、中後所二城，加半個前程。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed Prince Jirhalang in taking the two cities of Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo and was granted half a rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined Prince Jirhalang in taking Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo and received half a step of promotion credit.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，調鑲白旗，與固山額真巴哈納、石廷柱等招降山東府四、州七、縣三十二。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed in crossing the pass, was transferred to the Bordered White Banner, and with Gushan Ejen Bahana, Shi Tingzhu, and others induced the surrender of four prefectures, seven subprefectures, and thirty-two counties in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he crossed the pass, was transferred to the Bordered White Banner, and with Gushan Ejen Bahana, Shi Tingzhu, and others secured the submission of four prefectures, seven departments, and thirty-two counties in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 复移師下太原，招降山西府九、州二十七、縣一百四十一。

translations.literal: He again shifted the army south to Taiyuan and induced the surrender of nine prefectures, twenty-seven subprefectures, and one hundred forty-one counties in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He then marched on Taiyuan and won over nine prefectures, twenty-seven departments, and one hundred forty-one counties in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 師還，賜白金四百。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was granted four hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he received four hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 尋從豫親王多鐸西討李自成，定河南。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he followed Prince Dodo in the western campaign against Li Zicheng and settled Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He soon joined Prince Dodo's western campaign against Li Zicheng and helped secure Henan.

sentences.zh: 二年，移師徇江南，先後克揚州、嘉興，皆在行，進世職二等梅勒章京，賜蟒服、黃金三十、白金千五百。

translations.literal: In the second year the army shifted to subdue Jiangnan, successively taking Yangzhou and Jiaxing, with him present throughout; he was promoted to second-rank hereditary Meire Commander and granted python robes, thirty taels of gold, and fifteen hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the army turned to Jiangnan, taking Yangzhou and Jiaxing in turn with him in the column throughout. He was promoted to second-rank hereditary Meire Commander and given python robes, thirty taels of gold, and fifteen hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 五年，授定南將軍，與固山額真劉之源率左翼漢軍駐寶慶。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed Pacification General of the South and, with Gushan Ejen Liu Zhiyuan, led the left-wing Chinese Army in garrisoning Baoqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made Pacification General of the South and, with Gushan Ejen Liu Zhiyuan, garrisoned Baoqing with the left-wing Chinese Army.

sentences.zh: 時馬進忠等寇衡、湘、辰、永間，陷寶慶。

translations.literal: At that time Ma Jinzhong and others raided between Hengzhou, Xiangtan, Chenzhou, and Yongzhou and seized Baoqing.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Jinzhong and others were then raiding through Hengzhou, Xiangtan, Chenzhou, and Yongzhou and had taken Baoqing.

sentences.zh: 佟圖賴師至，克之。

translations.literal: When Tong Tu Lai's army arrived it recaptured the city.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Tu Lai marched in and retook the city.

sentences.zh: 六年，鄭親王濟爾哈朗徇湖廣，佟圖賴與固山額真碩詹等分兵趨衡州，陣斬明將陶養用，拔其城。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Prince Jirhalang subdued Huguang. Tong Tu Lai and Gushan Ejen Shuozhan and others divided forces toward Hengzhou, killed the Ming general Tao Yangyong in battle, and stormed the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Prince Jirhalang campaigned in Huguang. Tong Tu Lai and Gushan Ejen Shuozhan split forces toward Hengzhou, killed the Ming general Tao Yangyong in battle, and took the city.

sentences.zh: 時明將胡一清猶屯城南為七營，乘勝疾擊破之；

translations.literal: At that time the Ming general Hu Yiqing still held seven camps south of the city; they pressed the victory in a swift attack and broke them;
translations.idiomatic: The Ming general Hu Yiqing still held seven camps south of the city; they pressed their advantage and smashed them;

sentences.zh: 逐一清，戰於望公嶺山峪口，又破之；

translations.literal: pursued Yiqing and fought him at Wanggongling mountain pass, defeating him again;
translations.idiomatic: pursued Yiqing to Wanggongling pass and defeated him again;

sentences.zh: 一清走入廣西境，距全州三十里，立六營自保，與努山、阿濟格尼堪合軍奮擊，破之，遂下全州。

translations.literal: Yiqing fled into Guangxi territory, halted thirty li from Quanzhou, and drew up six camps to defend himself. Together with Nushan and Aji Ge Nikan they joined forces in a fierce attack, broke him, and then took Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yiqing fled into Guangxi, encamped thirty li from Quanzhou in six fortified camps, and was broken by a combined attack with Nushan and Aji Ge Nikan; Quanzhou then fell.

sentences.zh: 師還，駐衡州。

translations.literal: When the army returned it garrisoned Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The army returned and garrisoned Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 明兵犯常寧，遣牛錄額真陳天謨等馳援，破明兵石鼓洞，斬其渠。

translations.literal: When Ming troops attacked Changning he dispatched Company Ejen Chen Tianmo and others in rapid relief, defeated the Ming force at Shigudong, and beheaded their leader.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming forces attacked Changning he sent Company Ejen Chen Tianmo and others to their relief, routed the Ming troops at Shigudong, and killed their leader.

sentences.zh: 八年，師還，宴勞。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, when the army returned, he was feasted in reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on the army's return, he was honored at a feast.

sentences.zh: 授禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 復調正藍旗固山額真。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to be Gushan Ejen of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made Gushan Ejen of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 世職累進至三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: His hereditary rank was cumulatively advanced to third-rank Jingqi Niha.
translations.idiomatic: His hereditary rank rose cumulatively to third-rank Jingqi Niha.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以疾乞休，世祖命加太子太保致仕。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, on grounds of illness he requested retirement, and the Shizu emperor ordered him granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he retired on grounds of illness, and the Shizu emperor granted him Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with retirement honors.

sentences.zh: 十五年，卒，賜祭葬，贈少保，仍兼太子太保，諡勤襄。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he died. Sacrificial burial was granted, he was posthumously made Junior Guardian while retaining Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and was granted the posthumous title Qinxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he died. The court granted sacrificial burial, posthumously made him Junior Guardian while retaining Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and gave him the posthumous title Qinxiang.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，以孝康章皇后推恩所生，贈一等公，並命改隸滿洲。

translations.literal: In the Kangxi period, through the favor extended to the birth family of Empress Xiaokangzhang, he was posthumously made first-rank duke and ordered transferred to Manchu registration.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kangxi reign, through favor to Empress Xiaokangzhang's birth family, he was posthumously made first-rank duke and his line was transferred to Manchu registration.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，追封佟養正一等公，諡忠烈，與佟圖賴並加太師。

translations.literal: When the Yongzheng emperor took the throne he posthumously enfeoffed Tong Yangzheng as first-rank duke with the posthumous title Zhonglie, and Tong Tu Lai was also granted Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongzheng emperor ascended the throne he posthumously enfeoffed Tong Yangzheng as first-rank duke with the title Zhonglie, and Tong Tu Lai was also granted Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 養真改曰養正，避世宗嫌名也。

translations.literal: Yangzhen was changed to Yangzheng to avoid the Yongzheng emperor's tabooed name.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhen was renamed Yangzheng to avoid the Yongzheng emperor's tabooed name.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：圖賴忠鯁類父，督師南征，破福、唐二王，三江、閩、浙，以次底定，仍世侑饗，允哉！

translations.literal: Commentary says: Tu Lai was loyal and blunt like his father. Commanding armies on the southern campaign he broke the Princes of Fu and Tang; the three Jiangs, Fujian, and Zhejiang were settled in turn. Sacrificial offerings for generations — fitting indeed!
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: Tu Lai was as bluntly loyal as his father. Leading the southern campaigns he destroyed the Princes of Fu and Tang; the lower Yangtze, Fujian, and Zhejiang were secured in turn. That his line still receives temple offerings is only fitting!

sentences.zh: 準塔綏徠畿輔，戡定江、淮；

translations.literal: Zhun Ta pacified the capital region and settled Jiangnan and the Huai;
translations.idiomatic: Zhun Ta pacified the capital region and secured the Yangtze and Huai;

sentences.zh: 伊爾德橫海殺敵，破魯王餘眾，功與相並。

translations.literal: Yi Erde crossed the sea killing enemies and broke the remnant forces of the Prince of Lu; his merit ranks beside theirs.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Erde fought across the sea, broke the Prince of Lu's remnant forces, and ranks with them in merit.

sentences.zh: 努山、阿濟格尼堪、佟圖賴佐定江表，又合軍徇湘南。

translations.literal: Nushan, Aji Ge Nikan, and Tong Tu Lai assisted in settling the lands south of the Yangtze and again joined armies to subdue southern Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Nushan, Aji Ge Nikan, and Tong Tu Lai helped secure the south of the Yangtze and together campaigned in southern Hunan.

sentences.zh: 戮力佐創業，績亦偉矣！

translations.literal: Exerting their strength to assist in founding the dynasty, their achievements are indeed great!
translations.idiomatic: In lending their full strength to the founding of the dynasty, their achievements were truly great!
